Hierarchical Advantage Weighting for Online RL Fine-Tuning of VLAs from Sparse Episode Outcomes VLA

Hierarchical Advantage Weighting sparse episode outcomes VLA fine-tuning intervention-aware credit assignment state-adaptive gate

简要说明：提出层级化优势加权行为克隆（HABC），通过分离生存性和高效性的目标并采用状态自适应门控与干预感知的信用分配，在仅含稀疏二元结果的在线强化学习微调中提升VLA策略性能。

TLDR: Proposes Hierarchical Advantage Weighted Behavior Cloning (HABC) to fine-tune VLA policies with sparse binary outcomes by separating viability and efficiency objectives via separate critics and a state-adaptive gate, with intervention-aware credit assignment.

Abstract: When pretrained VLA policies are fine-tuned through online RL, each rollout episode produces only a single binary outcome (success or failure), yet the actor update requires per-transition supervision. Existing approaches commonly reduce this sparse outcome to a single scalar reward or advantage signal, which conflates distinct forms of transition-level feedback and provides limited guidance once basic task success becomes achievable. First, a single scalar signal conflates the two objectives of viability and efficiency; once basic success is achieved, the binary label provides no gradient to distinguish efficient completions from slow ones. Second, real-world rollouts mix autonomous and intervention segments; naively assigning episode outcomes across these boundaries introduces incorrect credit assignment. To address these issues, we propose Hierarchical Advantage-Weighted Behavior Cloning (HABC), which trains separate critic heads for these two objectives on different data subsets and combines their outputs with a state-adaptive balance. A state-adaptive gate $g_t$ merges their one-step advantages, prioritizing viability when success is uncertain and shifting to efficiency only when viability is high, and converts the result into per-transition weights on the actor loss. Intervention-aware credit assignment further restricts outcome labels to segments executed by the current policy, preventing supervision from leaking across intervention boundaries. In real-robot experiments on three contact-rich bimanual tasks, HABC raises success from supervised fine-tuning (SFT) baselines of 36%, 44%, and 12% to 92%, 88%, and 38%.

摘要（中文）：当预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通过在线强化学习进行微调时，每次交互回合仅产生单一的二元结果（成功或失败），然而策略更新却需要逐转换的监督信号。现有方法通常将这一稀疏结果简化为单个标量奖励或优势信号，这混淆了不同形式的转换级反馈，且一旦基础任务成功变得可实现，所能提供的指导就十分有限。首先，单一标量信号混淆了可执行性与效率这两个目标；一旦基本成功达成，二元标签无法提供梯度来区分高效完成与缓慢执行。其次，真实世界的交互滚动机交替包含自主执行段与人工干预段；若跨越这些边界简单地将回合结果赋予各段，将导致错误的信用分配。为解决这些问题，我们提出层级优势加权行为克隆（HABC）方法，该方法在不同数据子集上为这两个目标训练独立的评论家网络，并通过状态自适应平衡机制组合其输出。一个状态自适应门控信号$g_t$合并二者的单步优势，在成功不确定时优先考虑可执行性，仅当可执行性较高时才转向效率目标，并将结果转换为作用于策略损失的逐转换权重。干预感知的信用分配进一步将结果标签限制在当前策略执行的段内，防止监督信号跨越干预边界泄露。在三个接触式双臂操作任务的真实机器人实验中，HABC将监督微调（SFT）基线从36%、44%和12%提升至92%、88%和38%。

Authors: Tongyan Fang, Siyuan Huang, Naiyu Fang, Ganlong Zhao, Zhongjin Luo, Jianbo Liu, Xiaogang Wang, Ying Dong, Hongsheng Li

Unified Motion-Action Modeling for Heterogeneous Robot Learning VLA

UMA object motion trajectories masked generative objective multi-task pretraining visuomotor control

简要说明：该论文提出统一运动-动作模型（UMA），使用3D物体运动轨迹作为共享接口，统一异构机器人数据的视觉运动控制与动力学建模，单个预训练模型支持多种推理模式。

TLDR: The paper proposes UMA, which uses 3D object motion trajectories as a shared interface to unify visuomotor control and dynamics modeling across heterogeneous robot data, supporting multiple inference modes with a single pretrained model.

Abstract: We present Unified Motion-Action (UMA) Model, an approach that uses 3D object motion trajectories as a shared interface to bridge visuomotor control and dynamics modeling. UMA treats object motion and robot actions as co-evolving variables under a masked generative objective, in which the mask pattern determines both the supervision regime during pretraining and the inference mode at deployment. Using hindsight-relabeled motion contexts and a contrastive objective that disentangles task intent from scene geometry, UMA enables multi-task pretraining across heterogeneous data sources without requiring manually annotated task instructions. At deployment, the same pretrained parameters support motion-conditioned visuomotor control, motion-based dynamics modeling, and task adaptation from few-shot demonstrations. Pretrained on a mixture of robot demonstrations, human videos, and simulated data, UMA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines specialized for each inference mode.

摘要（中文）：我们提出统一运动-动作（UMA）模型，该模型将三维物体运动轨迹作为共享接口，以连接视觉运动控制与动力学建模。UMA将物体运动与机器人动作视为在掩码生成目标下共同演化的变量，其中掩码模式既决定了预训练期间的监督机制，也决定了部署时的推理模式。利用事后重新标注的运动情境及用于分离任务意图与场景几何的对比学习目标，UMA能够在无需人工标注任务指令的情况下，实现对异构数据源的多任务预训练。在部署阶段，相同的预训练参数支持运动条件视觉运动控制、基于运动的动力学建模，以及通过少量示例样本进行任务自适应。通过在机器人演示数据、人类视频与模拟数据的混合集上进行预训练，UMA在各项推理模式下均持续优于针对特定模式优化的最先进基线方法。

Authors: Yunhao Cao, Shitong Liu, Chao Feng, Meryl Zhang, Xuanchen Lu, Andrew Owens, Kuan Fang

Qwen-RobotWorld Technical Report: Unifying Embodied World Modeling through Language-Conditioned Video Generation WorldModel

language-conditioned video generation world model embodied intelligence double-stream MMDiT embodied world knowledge

简要说明：Qwen-RobotWorld 是一个语言条件视频世界模型，将机器人操作、自动驾驶、室内导航和人机迁移等具身世界建模统一起来，支持合成数据生成、虚拟评估和规划引导。

TLDR: Qwen-RobotWorld is a language-conditioned video world model that unifies embodied world modeling across robotic manipulation, autonomous driving, indoor navigation, and human-to-robot transfer, enabling synthetic data generation, virtual evaluation, and planning guidance.

Abstract: We introduce Qwen-RobotWorld, a language-conditioned video world model for embodied intelligence. With natural language as a unified action interface, it predicts physically grounded future visual trajectories from current observations across robotic manipulation, autonomous driving, indoor navigation, and human-to-robot transfer. This unified formulation provides three promising application directions: synthetic data generation for policy training augmentation, scalable virtual environments for policy evaluation, and language-guided planning signals for downstream robot control. This is achieved through a three-part design: a) Double-Stream MMDiT with MLLM Action Encoding, where a 60-layer double-stream diffusion transformer couples frozen Qwen2.5-VL semantics with video-VAE latents through layer-wise joint attention; b) Embodied World Knowledge (EWK), an 8.6M video-text corpus (200M+ frames) with action-language mapping over 20+ embodiments and 500+ action categories; and c) General+Expert Progressive Curriculum, a two-stage training strategy that first learns general visual priors and then injects embodied specialization under a shared language interface. Extensive results show strong competitiveness: ranks 1st overall on EWMBench and DreamGen Bench, outperforms all open-source models on WorldModelBench and PBench. Additional zero-shot analyses on RoboTwin-IF benchmark further support robust generalization and multi-view consistency.

摘要（中文）：我们提出Qwen-RobotWorld，一种面向具身智能的语言条件视频世界模型。以自然语言作为统一动作接口，该模型能够根据当前观测预测机器人操作、自动驾驶、室内导航以及人机迁移等场景中符合物理规律的未来视觉轨迹。这一统一框架提供了三个有前景的应用方向：用于策略训练增强的合成数据生成、用于策略评估的可扩展虚拟环境，以及为下游机器人控制提供语言引导的规划信号。该模型通过三部分设计实现：a) 双流MMDiT与多模态大语言模型动作编码——一个60层双流扩散Transformer通过层级联合注意力机制将冻结的Qwen2.5-VL语义与视频变分自编码器潜在特征相耦合；b) 具身世界知识库——包含860万条视频文本对（超过2亿帧），涵盖20余种具身形态和500余种动作类别的动作语言映射；c) 通用+专家渐进式课程——两阶段训练策略，先学习通用视觉先验，再在共享语言接口下注入具身专长。大量实验结果表明该模型具备强竞争力：在EWMBench和DreamGen Bench上排名第一，在WorldModelBench和PBench上超越所有开源模型。针对RoboTwin-IF基准的额外零样本分析进一步验证了其鲁棒泛化能力和多视角一致性。

Authors: Jie Zhang, Xiaoyue Chen, Anzhe Chen, Deqing Li, Gengze Zhou, Hale Yin, Haoqi Yuan, Haoyang Li, Jiahao Li, Jiazhao Zhang, Jingren Zhou, Kaiyuan Gao, Kun Yan, Lihan Jiang, Ningyuan Tang, Pei Lin, Qihang Peng, Shengming Yin, Tianhe Wu, Tianyi Yan, Xiao Xu, Yan Shu, Yanran Zhang, Ye Wang, Yi Wang, Yilei Chen, Yixian Xu, Yiyang Huang, Yuxiang Chen, Zekai Zhang, Zhendong Wang, Zixing Lei, Zhixuan Liang, Zihao Liu, Zikai Zhou, Chenxu Lv, Xiong-Hui Chen, Chenfei Wu

T-Rex: Tactile-Reactive Dexterous Manipulation Manipulation

tactile-reactive dexterous manipulation Mixture-of-Transformers VLA models tactile VQ-VAE

简要说明：本文提出T-Rex，一种触觉反应性灵巧操作系统，通过大规模触觉数据集、可变速率混合变换器架构和时间触觉VQ-VAE，在精细操作任务上比现有基线方法成功率提高超过30%。

TLDR: This paper introduces T-Rex, a tactile-reactive dexterous manipulation system that combines a large-scale tactile dataset, a variable-rate Mixture-of-Transformers architecture, and a temporal tactile VQ-VAE to achieve over 30% higher success rates on delicate manipulation tasks compared to existing baselines.

Abstract: The ability to react dynamically to tactile signals has long been considered crucial to agile human-level dexterity. Yet contemporary learning-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for robotic manipulation generally either overlook the tactile modality or are limited to encoders with static cues, due in part to the scarcity of diverse training data and standardized evaluation, architectural constraints in current VLA models, and limitations of static tactile encoders. In this paper, we push the frontier of tactile-reactive manipulation by addressing all of these limitations. We propose a large-scale, 100-hour tactile-rich dataset collected via a novel, data-efficient recipe that prioritizes elementary motor primitives. To effectively exploit naturally high-frequency touch signals without sacrificing the existing capabilities of existing VLAs, we introduce a variable-rate Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture equipped with a novel temporal tactile VQ-VAE encoder. We demonstrate the effectiveness of tactile-reactive policies on 12 manipulation tasks requiring delicate force control and deformable object manipulation, achieving over 30% higher average success rate than the strongest baseline.

摘要（中文）：对触觉信号做出动态响应的能力，长期以来一直被视为实现类人灵巧操作的关键。然而，当前基于学习的机器人操作视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，要么完全忽略触觉模态，要么受限于使用静态线索的编码器——部分原因在于多样化训练数据和标准化评估的匮乏、当前VLA模型架构的限制，以及静态触觉编码器的局限性。在本文中，我们通过解决上述所有限制来推进触觉反应操作的前沿。我们提出了一种大规模、包含100小时触觉丰富数据的数据集，该数据集通过一种新颖且数据高效的采集方案收集，优先考虑了基础运动基元。为了在保持现有VLA模型既有能力的同时有效利用自然高频触觉信号，我们引入了一种变速率混合变换器（MoT）架构，并配备了新颖的时间触觉VQ-VAE编码器。我们在12个需要精细力控制和可变形物体操作的任务上验证了触觉反应策略的有效性，相较于最强基线实现了超过30%的平均成功率提升。

Authors: Dantong Niu, Zhuoyang Liu, Zekai Wang, Boning Shao, Zhao-Heng Yin, Anirudh Pai, Yuvan Sharma, Stefano Saravalle, Ruijie Zheng, Jing Wang, Ryan Punamiya, Mengda Xu, Yuqi Xie, Yunfan Jiang, Letian Fu, Konstantinos Kallidromitis, Matteo Gioia, Junyi Zhang, Jiaxin Ge, Haiwen Feng, Fabio Galasso, Wei Zhan, David M. Chan, Yutong Bai, Roei Herzig, Jiahui Lei, Fei-Fei Li, Ken Goldberg, Jitendra Malik, Pieter Abbeel, Yuke Zhu, Danfei Xu, Jim, Fan, Trevor Darrell

Human Universal Grasping VLA

flow-matching human grasping egocentric dataset MANO hand pose zero-shot robot grasping

简要说明：一种基于流匹配的模型，能从单张RGB-D图像生成多样化的人类抓取姿态，并通过重定向到不同机器人手部实现零样本抓取，配套新基准和真实世界验证。

TLDR: A flow-matching model that generates diverse human grasps from a single RGB-D image, demonstrated to enable zero-shot robot grasping by retargeting to various robot hands with a new benchmark and real-world validation.

Abstract: Humans can grasp objects effortlessly, whereas multi-fingered robots are far from this level of generality. We argue that the most natural source of robot grasping data is from humans, who pick up thousands of objects every day. We present HUG, a flow-matching model that generates diverse human grasps for any user-specified object in a single RGB-D image captured from a stereo camera. Using smart glasses, we first collect 1M-HUGs, an egocentric dataset of human grasps spanning 1M frames (27.8 hrs) and 6,707 object instances across 41 buildings. Next, to model the distribution of natural human grasps, our novel flow-matching model fuses RGB and depth observations to output a grasp parameterized by wrist translation, wrist rotation, and MANO hand pose. Predicted grasps can be retargeted to various robot hands, enabling zero-shot grasping in everyday scenes. To standardize evaluation, we build a new simulated benchmark, HUG-Bench, of 90 unseen objects from five geometric categories and various sizes, with metric-scale 3D meshes. We evaluate HUG in the real world on the 30-object test set of HUG-Bench across multiple stereo cameras, robot embodiments, and household environments. HUG outperforms the state-of-the-art grasping baselines by +23% and +34% on our challenging object set. Code, data, benchmark, checkpoints, and an interactive demo are released on our website: https://grasping.io/

摘要（中文）：人类可以毫不费力地抓取物体，而多指机器人远未达到这一通用水平。我们认为，机器人抓取数据最自然的来源是每天拿起数千件物品的人类。我们提出HUG——一种流匹配模型，能够基于立体摄像头拍摄的单张RGB-D图像，为用户指定的任意物体生成多样化的人手抓取姿态。通过智能眼镜，我们首先收集了1M-HUGs——一个以自我为中心的人手抓取数据集，涵盖100万帧（27.8小时）、跨越41栋建筑的6,707个物体实例。接着，为建模自然人手抓取的分布，我们新颖的流匹配模型融合RGB与深度观测数据，输出由手腕平移、手腕旋转及MANO手部姿态参数化的抓取结果。预测的抓取可重定向至多种机器人手部，实现日常场景中的零样本抓取。为标准化评估，我们构建了新的仿真基准HUG-Bench，包含来自五个几何类别及多种尺寸的90个未见物体，并配有公制尺度3D网格。我们在真实世界中，使用HUG-Bench的30个物体测试集，结合多种立体摄像头、机器人本体及家庭环境对HUG进行了评估。在我们具有挑战性的物体集上，HUG分别以+23%和+34%的优势超越了最先进的抓取基线。代码、数据、基准、检查点及交互式演示均已发布于我们的网站：https://grasping.io/

Authors: Kevin Yuanbo Wu, Tianxing Zhou, Isaac Tu, Billy Yan, Irmak Guzey, David Fouhey, Dandan Shan, Lerrel Pinto

Geometric Action Model for Robot Policy Learning Manipulation

Geometric Action Model vision-language-action models world-action models geometric foundation model manipulation policy

简要说明：GAM将预训练的几何基础模型重新用作感知、时间预测和动作解码的共享骨干，实现了利用3D几何先验的语言条件操控策略。

TLDR: GAM repurposes a pretrained geometric foundation model as a shared backbone for perception, temporal prediction, and action decoding, enabling language-conditioned manipulation policies that leverage 3D geometric priors.

Abstract: Generalist robot policies must follow user instructions while reasoning about how objects, cameras, and robot actions interact in the 3D physical world. Recent vision-language-action models (VLAs) and video world-action models (WAMs) inherit strong semantic or temporal priors from large-scale foundation models, but they still operate primarily on 2D image frames or 2D-derived latent spaces, leaving implicit the 3D geometry required for contact-rich manipulation. We propose the Geometric Action Model (GAM), a language-conditioned manipulation policy that directly repurposes a pretrained geometric foundation model (GFM) as a shared substrate for perception, temporal prediction, and action decoding. GAM splits the GFM at an intermediate layer: the shallow layers serve as an observation encoder, and a causal future predictor inserted at the split layer forecasts future latent tokens conditioned on language, proprioception, and action history. The predicted future tokens are then routed through the remaining GFM blocks for feature propagation and decoding, allowing a single backbone to produce both future geometry and actions. This design equips the GFM with language-conditioned temporal world modeling through minimal architectural modification while preserving its rich geometric priors. Across a broad suite of simulation and real-robot manipulation benchmarks, GAM is more accurate, more robust, faster, and lighter than current foundation-model-scale baselines.

摘要（中文）：通用型机器人策略必须遵循用户指令，同时推理物体、相机与机器人动作在三维物理世界中的交互方式。近年来的视觉-语言-动作模型和视频世界-动作模型虽然继承了大尺度基础模型强大的语义或时间先验，但其核心操作仍基于二维图像帧或源自二维的隐空间，因此隐含了接触密集型操作所需的三维几何信息。我们提出几何动作模型，这是一种语言条件化的操控策略，直接复用预训练的几何基础模型作为感知、时间预测与动作解码的共享基座。GAM在几何基础模型的中间层进行拆分：浅层作为观测编码器，并在拆分处插入因果未来预测器，基于语言、本体感知与动作历史预测未来的隐层令牌。随后，预测得到的未来令牌通过剩余几何基础模型模块进行特征传播与解码，从而使得单一主干网络能够同时生成未来几何信息与动作。该设计通过最小化的架构修改，赋予几何基础模型语言条件化的时间世界建模能力，同时保留其丰富的几何先验。在涵盖仿真与真实机器人操控的广泛基准测试中，GAM在准确性、鲁棒性、速度与轻量性方面均优于当前基于基础模型尺度的基线方案。

Authors: Jisang Han, Seonghu Jeon, Jaewoo Jung, René Zurbrügg, Honggyu An, Tifanny Portela, Marco Hutter, Marc Pollefeys, Seungryong Kim, Sunghwan Hong

ROVE: Unlocking Human Interventions for Humanoid Manipulation via Reinforcement Learning VLA

reinforcement learning humanoid manipulation value estimation VLA post-training human-in-the-loop

简要说明：ROVE 提出了一种强化学习框架，利用乐观价值估计和跨形态人类视频，从非完美的人类干预数据中后训练人形机器人 VLA 策略。

TLDR: ROVE introduces a reinforcement learning framework that uses Optimistic Value Estimation and cross-embodiment human videos to post-train humanoid VLA policies from imperfect human intervention data.

Abstract: Human interventions provide crucial corrective signals for post-training Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. However, enabling seamless humanoid interventions is a formidable systems challenge due to complex whole-body kinematics and dexterous-hand control. Consequently, the collected intervention trajectories are often suboptimal, and methods that rely on human interventions as expert supervision can absorb hesitant, inefficient, or even erroneous behaviors. To address both the system and algorithmic challenges, we propose ROVE, a reinforcement learning framework for humanoid VLA post-training with imperfect human interventions. First, ROVE introduces a human-in-the-loop pipeline capable of collecting deployment and intervention data for humanoid manipulation. Second, it utilizes Optimistic Value Estimation (OVE) to prioritize high-value behaviors from mixed-quality trajectories. To further robustify value estimation, we incorporate cross-embodiment human experience videos to provide rich supervision for long-tailed failure and recovery modes. The resulting critic yields informative advantage signals, steering the VLA actor to focus on high-value behaviors rather than indiscriminately imitating all actions. On challenging real-world contact-rich and fine-grained humanoid manipulation tasks, ROVE outperforms experience-learning baselines and consistently improves across multiple rollout-intervention iterations.

摘要（中文）：人类干预为视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的后训练提供了关键的修正信号。然而，由于复杂的人形全身运动学与灵巧手控制，实现无缝的人形干预是一项艰巨的系统性挑战。由此收集的干预轨迹往往并非最优，依赖人类干预作为专家监督的方法可能会吸收犹豫、低效甚至错误的动作。为应对系统与算法两方面的挑战，我们提出ROVE——一种面向不完美人类干预下的人形VLA后训练的强化学习框架。首先，ROVE引入了一个人在回路的管线，能够收集人形操控的部署与干预数据。其次，它利用乐观价值估计（OVE）从混合质量的轨迹中优先选取高价值行为。为进一步增强价值估计的鲁棒性，我们融入跨具身的人类经验视频，为长尾失败与恢复模式提供丰富的监督信号。由此产生的评价器生成富有信息量的优势信号，引导VLA动作器专注于高价值行为，而非不加区分地模仿所有动作。在具有挑战性的真实世界接触密集型与精细人形操控任务中，ROVE表现优于基于经验学习的方法，并在多轮部署-干预迭代中持续提升。

Authors: Wei Xiao, Weiliang Tang, Yuying Ge, Hui Zhou, Yao Mu, Li Zhang, Yixiao Ge

ATOM-Bench: A Real-World Benchmark for Atomic Skills and Compositional Generalization in Manipulation Policies Manipulation

atomic skills compositional generalization manipulation policies real-world benchmark robot foundation models

简要说明：ATOM-Bench 是一个真实世界的基准，用于评估操作策略中的原子技能习得和组合泛化能力，包含 30 个原子任务、24 个组合任务以及配对单/双臂机器人轨迹和 3,000 个人类演示。

TLDR: ATOM-Bench is a real-world benchmark for evaluating atomic skill acquisition and compositional generalization in manipulation policies, using 30 atomic tasks, 24 compositional tasks, and paired single/dual-arm robot tracks with 3,000 human demonstrations.

Abstract: Generalist manipulation policies are increasingly presented as foundation models for robotic control, but their real-world generalization remains difficult to diagnose. A policy may succeed on demonstrated tasks while still failing to execute fine-grained atomic skills or recombine learned skills in new task structures. We introduce \textbf{ATOM-Bench}, a real-world benchmark for evaluating both atomic skills and compositional generalization in manipulation policies. ATOM-Bench factorizes tabletop manipulation into motor atoms and instruction atoms, and contains 30 atomic tasks and 24 held-out compositional tasks across paired single-arm and dual-arm robot tracks. We collect 3,000 human demonstrations for atomic fine-tuning and release both the demonstration data and evaluation rollout data to support reproducible real-world evaluation. Policies are fine-tuned on atomic tasks and evaluated on both atomic skill acquisition and held-out compositional tasks. We further introduce Atomic Score (AS) and Compositional Failure Share (CFS) to distinguish failures caused by weak atomic skills from failures caused by limited compositional reuse. Through 2,700 physical rollouts on five representative manipulation policies, we find that current policies can acquire simple instruction-grounding skills, but still struggle with fine-grained motor atoms, counting, and logical filtering. More importantly, strong atomic performance does not reliably transfer to held-out compositional tasks. ATOM-Bench provides a diagnostic testbed for studying whether failures arise from weak motor execution, poor instruction grounding, or limited compositional reuse.

摘要（中文）：通用操作策略正日益被视为机器人控制的基础模型，但其在现实世界中的泛化能力仍然难以诊断。某项策略可能成功完成演示任务，却无法执行细粒度的原子技能，或无法将已学技能重组至新的任务结构中。我们提出 **ATOM-Bench**，一个用于评估操作策略中原子技能与组合泛化能力的真实世界基准。ATOM-Bench 将桌面操作分解为运动原子和指令原子，包含30个原子任务和24个预留的组合任务，涵盖单臂与双臂机器人两条并行赛道。我们收集了3000组用于原子微调的人类演示数据，并同时发布演示数据与评估展开数据，以支持可复现的真实世界评估。策略在原子任务上进行微调，并在原子技能获取与预留组合任务两方面接受评估。我们进一步引入原子得分（AS）与组合失败分担率（CFS），以区分由原子技能薄弱导致的失败与由组合复用能力不足导致的失败。通过对五种代表性操作策略进行2700次物理展开实验，我们发现当前策略能够习得简单的指令接地技能，但在细粒度运动原子、计数与逻辑过滤方面仍存在困难。更重要的是，强大的原子性能并不能可靠地迁移至预留的组合任务。ATOM-Bench 为研究失败源于运动执行薄弱、指令接地欠佳还是组合复用受限提供了诊断性测试平台。

Authors: Zenan Wu, Bingqing Wei, Lu Liu, Zheqi He, Xi Wang, Jiakang Liu, Zehui Li, Guocai Yao, Jing-Shu Zheng, Xi Yang, Yongtao Wang

DIFF-IPPO: Diffusion-Based Informative Path Planning with Open-Vocabulary Belief Maps VLN

diffusion-based planner informative path planning open-vocabulary belief maps exploration object search

简要说明：DIFF-IPPO 将开放词汇置信图生成器与基于扩散的规划器相结合，用于机器人在探索与物体搜索中的全局轨迹生成，在无人机编队模拟搜救场景中实现了高检测率。

TLDR: DIFF-IPPO integrates an open-vocabulary belief map generator with a diffusion-based planner for global trajectory generation in robotic exploration and object search, achieving high detection scores in simulated search-and-rescue scenarios with drone teams.

Abstract: Exploration and object search require robots to perceive their environment, identify regions of interest, and plan trajectories that improve target-detection likelihood or maximize information gain. Many IPP methods, especially in continuous environmental monitoring, rely on Gaussian-process belief models, while object-search settings often produce complex, multimodal belief maps from semantic or open-vocabulary perception. Global trajectory generation directly conditioned on such non-Gaussian belief maps remains comparatively underexplored. Although diffusion-based planners offer strong capabilities for modeling such distributions, their use in informative path planning remains limited. In this work, we propose DIFF-IPPO, a pipeline that integrates an open-vocabulary belief map generator with a diffusion-based planner for global trajectory generation over belief maps. The method generates trajectories that concentrate sensor coverage over high-belief regions, achieving normalized detection scores between 81.49% and 86.55% across different dataset scenarios. We validate the system in a simulated search-and-rescue scenario where the planner searches candidate building regions to locate a burning building. In this setting, a team of five drones using batched belief-map-conditioned trajectory generation achieves first detections in 3.5 minutes.

摘要（中文）：探索与目标搜索要求机器人能够感知环境、识别感兴趣区域，并规划可提高目标检测概率或最大化信息增益的轨迹。许多信息路径规划（IPP）方法（尤其在连续环境监测中）依赖于高斯过程置信度模型，而目标搜索场景通常通过语义或开放词汇感知生成复杂的多模态置信度地图。直接基于此类非高斯置信度地图进行全局轨迹生成的研究仍相对不足。尽管基于扩散的规划器在建模此类分布方面具有强大能力，但其在信息路径规划中的应用仍然有限。本文提出DIFF-IPPO流程，该流程将开放词汇置信度地图生成器与基于扩散的规划器相结合，用于在置信度地图上生成全局轨迹。该方法生成的轨迹能够将传感器覆盖集中于高置信度区域，在不同数据集场景下实现了81.49%至86.55%的归一化检测得分。我们在模拟的搜索与救援场景中验证了该系统，规划器通过搜索候选建筑区域定位着火建筑。在该场景中，由五架无人机组成的编队采用批量置信度地图条件轨迹生成方法，在3.5分钟内实现了首次检测。

Authors: Sausar Karaf, Oleg Sautenkov, Mikhail Martynov, Dzmitry Tsetserukou

DataLadder: A Simulation-Enabled Interconversion Toolchain for the Embodied Data Pyramid Manipulation

sim-to-real digital twin data generation model evaluation embodied data pyramid

简要说明：DataLadder 提出了一个基于仿真的工具链，实现真实机器人操作、仿真与人类演示之间的相互转换，以支持具身智能模型的可扩展评估和数据生成。

TLDR: DataLadder presents a simulation-enabled toolchain that interconverts between real robot operations, simulation, and human demonstrations to enable scalable model evaluation and data generation for embodied AI.

Abstract: Generalist robot policies require trustworthy evaluation and robot-usable training data, but both are difficult to scale with physical robots alone. Real-robot trials and demonstrations remain the most faithful source of deployment signals, yet they are slow, costly, and hard to reproduce. We present DataLadder, a simulation-enabled interconversion toolchain for human-robot aligned model evaluation and data generation, denoted as Robot $\rightleftharpoons$ Simulation $\rightleftharpoons$ Human. On the one hand, the Robot $\rightarrow$ Simulation $\rightarrow$ Human pathway supports human-robot aligned model evaluation by reconstructing real-robot tabletop organization tasks as calibrated digital twins for scalable evaluation, while using human embodied feedback to inspect and refine the naturalness of simulated motions. On the other hand, the Human $\rightarrow$ Simulation $\rightarrow$ Robot pathway supports human-robot aligned data generation: it lifts ego-centric human demonstrations into simulation, checks them under robot physical constraints, and converts them into robot-centered trajectories, annotations, and visual observations. Together, these pathways use the JoySim simulator as both a scalable evaluation layer and a physical consistency filter for robot data generation. We further package the core reconstruction, simulation, rendering, and realism-augmentation modules as cloud services on JD Cloud, turning the system into reusable infrastructure for robot data generation and model evaluation.

摘要（中文）：通用型机器人策略需要可信的评估和可供机器人使用的训练数据，但仅依靠实体机器人难以实现规模化扩展。真实机器人试验与示范仍是部署信号最可靠的来源，然而这些方法耗时、成本高昂且难以复现。我们提出DataLadder——一种支持模拟环境与真实场景互转的工具链，用于实现人机协同的模型评估与数据生成，其范式可表述为：机器人 $\rightleftharpoons$ 模拟环境 $\rightleftharpoons$ 人类。一方面，通过“机器人→模拟环境→人类”路径，将真实机器人的桌面组织任务重建为校准后的数字孪生体，实现可扩展的评估，同时借助人类具身反馈检验并优化模拟动作的自然度；另一方面，通过“人类→模拟环境→机器人”路径，将第一人称人类示范数据迁移至模拟环境，在机器人物理约束下进行校验，并将其转换为以机器人为中心的轨迹、标注信息及视觉观测数据。这两条路径依托JoySim模拟器，既作为可扩展的评估层，又充当机器人数据生成的物理一致性过滤器。我们进一步将核心重建、仿真、渲染及真实感增强模块封装为京东云上的云服务，使该系统成为机器人数据生成与模型评估的可复用基础设施。

Authors: Peidong Liu, Yongce Liu, Songyan Guo, Fuyuan Ma, Zhihao Yuan, Ao Li, Zengjue Chen, Wenhao Li, Tianle Zhang, Mingyang Li, Jiale Zhang, Junzhe Xiong, Zhiyuan Xiang, Dafeng Chi, Yuzheng Zhuang, Yihang Li, Qingrong He, Jiaming Liang, Chen Cai, Peng Hao, Mingxi Luo, Song Wang, Junwu Xiong, Ruodai Li, Liyi Luo, Wei Tan, Dongjiang Li, Jiawei Li, Hui Shen, Yicheng Gong, Liang Lin

Pride and Prejudice: Toward an Information-Theoretic Framework for Mutually Communicative Driver Behavior Modeling AutonomousDriving

mixed autonomy lane change prediction Bayesian persuasion game information-theoretic rewards C-MIRL

简要说明：提出一个基于博弈论和信息论的框架，建模自动驾驶车辆与人类驾驶员在变道中的隐式相互沟通，在NGSIM数据集上将预测误差降低20%。

TLDR: A game-theoretic and information-theoretic framework models mutual implicit communication between autonomous and human vehicles during lane changes, reducing prediction error by 20% on NGSIM.

Abstract: Mixed autonomy driving becomes unsafe and inefficient when autonomous vehicles (AVs) and human-driven vehicles (HVs) misread each other's intentions. We study this problem as implicit mutual communication in lane changes. The proposed framework models how the ego vehicle both expresses its intent and probes the other driver's preference under epistemic uncertainty. It combines a level-k Bayesian persuasion game with virtual features for proactive signaling, information-theoretic rewards for mutual communication, and adaptive weights of communication affordances. We further introduce the Pride-Inquiry (P-I) and Pride-Prejudice (P-P) planes to analyze communication intensity and tendency. The model is calibrated with a Communication-Based Multi-Agent Inverse Reinforcement Learning algorithm (C-MIRL) on the naturalistic NGSIM dataset. Compared with the non-communicative baseline, the proposed model reduces the prediction error of mandatory lane changes by up to 20% while maintaining strong generalization. Driver-In-the-Loop questionnaire scores are positively correlated with the calibrated communication variables, supporting the subjective validity of the model. The learned rewards further show that inquiry and listening affordances contribute more than pride and expression alone, and that inquiry preference varies more strongly across drivers. These results support explicit modeling of mutual communication and epistemic uncertainty in interactive driving.

摘要（中文）：当自动驾驶车辆（AV）与人类驾驶车辆（HV）彼此误解意图时，混合自主驾驶将变得不安全且低效。本研究将这一问题视作变道场景中的隐性相互通信。所提出的框架对自车如何在认知不确定性下表达自身意图并探测其他驾驶员的偏好进行了建模。该框架融合了用于主动信号传递的层级k贝叶斯说服博弈与虚拟特征、用于相互通信的信息论奖励，以及通信可供性的自适应权重。我们进一步引入了“自豪-探询（P-I）”与“自豪-偏见（P-P）”平面来分析通信强度与倾向。该模型通过基于通信的多智能体逆向强化学习算法（C-MIRL）在自然驾驶数据集NGSIM上进行标定。与非通信基线相比，所提模型将强制变道的预测误差降低了20%，同时保持了较强的泛化能力。驾驶员在环问卷评分与标定后的通信变量呈正相关，支持了该模型的主观有效性。学习到的奖励进一步表明，探询与倾听的可供性比自豪与表达本身贡献更大，且驾驶员之间的探询偏好差异更为显著。这些结果支持在交互式驾驶中对相互通信与认知不确定性进行显式建模。

Authors: Tingjun Li, Nan Xu, Shuo Feng, Hassan Askari, Bruno Henrique Groenner Barbosa, Konghui Guo

PATCH: Action-Chunk-Conditioned Latent Patch Innovation Monitoring for Robot Manipulation Manipulation

runtime monitor action chunk latent patch robot manipulation disturbance-aware

简要说明：PATCH 提出了一种动作块条件化的潜在斑块创新监控器，通过追踪机器人自身运动无法解释的残差来检测操作过程中的局部执行风险，从而实现运行时干预和策略恢复。

TLDR: PATCH introduces an action-chunk-conditioned latent patch innovation monitor that detects localized execution risk during robot manipulation by tracking residuals unexplained by the robot's own motion, enabling runtime intervention and policy resumption.

Abstract: Learning-based manipulation policies have made substantial progress in real-world robot manipulation, particularly for short-horizon action generation. However, deployment in open workspaces remains fragile under unexpected local scene dynamics, such as moving objects, transient occlusions, or disturbances near the intended motion. Existing runtime monitors often rely on global observation anomalies, policy uncertainty, or frame-level visual changes, and struggle to distinguish task-relevant execution risk from benign visual variation. We introduce PATCH, an action-chunk-conditioned latent patch innovation monitor for deployment-time intervention. Given the active action chunk, PATCH defines a projected execution corridor, predicts latent patch evolution inside it, and accumulates persistent residuals unexplained by the robot's own motion. These residuals form a localized intervention signal that allows PATCH-Router to pause execution, select an available recovery source, and resume the original policy once localized innovation subsides. Experiments on real robot rollout data show that PATCH produces more stable and context-relevant triggers than competing runtime monitors. Real-robot deployment further demonstrates monitor-driven intervention and policy resumption for disturbance-aware manipulation. Project Page: https://yananzhou5555.github.io/PATCH/.

摘要（中文）：基于学习的操控策略在真实机器人操控中取得了实质性进展，尤其在短视野动作生成方面。然而，在开放工作空间中部署时，该策略在面对意外的局部场景动态（如移动物体、瞬时遮挡或目标运动附近的干扰）时仍然脆弱。现有的运行时监控器通常依赖于全局观测异常、策略不确定性或帧级视觉变化，难以将任务相关的执行风险与良性的视觉变化区分开来。我们提出PATCH——一种基于动作片段条件化的潜在补丁创新监控器，用于部署时的干预。给定当前的动作片段，PATCH定义一个投影执行走廊，预测其内部的潜在补丁演化，并累积机器人自身运动无法解释的持续残差。这些残差形成局部化的干预信号，使PATCH-Router能够暂停执行、选择可用的恢复源，并在局部创新平息后恢复原始策略。在实际机器人 rollout 数据上的实验表明，PATCH生成的触发信号比现有运行时监控器更稳定、更符合上下文。真实机器人部署进一步展示了基于监控器的干预与策略恢复，用于感知干扰的操控。项目页面：https://yananzhou5555.github.io/PATCH/。

Authors: Yanan Zhou, Ranpeng Qiu, Yincong Chen, Jiajie Cui, Weiming Zhi

WaveSync: Constrained Wavefront Optimization for Synchronized Co-Speech Gestures in Humanoid Robots HumanoidEmbodied

co-speech gesture humanoid robot Dynamic Movement Primitives Wavefront Optimization semantic importance wave

简要说明：WaveSync 是一个混合框架，结合了基于大语言模型的语义分解、波前优化和动态运动基元，在人形机器人上生成同步且运动学可行的共语手势。

TLDR: WaveSync is a hybrid framework that combines LLM-based semantic decomposition with Wavefront Optimization and Dynamic Movement Primitives to generate synchronized, kinematically feasible co-speech gestures on humanoid robots.

Abstract: Expressive co-speech gestures are crucial for natural human-robot interaction, but generating them on physical humanoid robots is difficult because gesture strokes must align with speech emphasis while satisfying strict kinematic and dynamic constraints. Unlike virtual avatars, humanoid robots cannot freely execute rapid or overlapping motions, making word-level synchronization and hardware-safe motion planning a coupled problem. We present \textbf{WaveSync}, a hybrid framework in which a Large Language Model decomposes dialogue responses into structured semantic schemas and assigns per-word importance weights, constructing a continuous Semantic Importance Wave. Gesture trajectories are shaped through Dynamic Movement Primitives, enforcing kinematic feasibility while enhancing expressiveness. A Wavefront Optimization stage aligns peak-to-peak gesture-speech synchronization and resolves residual kinematic violations through gesture-duration compression and forward propagation. Experimental evaluation based on five dialogue scenarios shows that our method achieves high synchronization accuracy and outperforms three baselines in both objective and subjective evaluations. Each component in WaveSync plays a necessary role in producing gestures that are expressive, semantically grounded, and kinematically compliant. The code, resources, and videos are available at \href{https://github.com/pairs-lab/WaveSync}{WaveSync}

摘要（中文）：表达性共语手势对于自然的人机交互至关重要，但在实体人形机器人上生成这些手势却充满挑战，因为手势的起落必须与语音重音对齐，同时满足严格的运动学和动力学约束。与虚拟化身不同，人形机器人无法自由执行快速或重叠的运动，这使得词语级别的同步与硬件安全的运动规划成为一个耦合问题。我们提出\textbf{WaveSync}，一个混合框架，其中大语言模型将对话响应分解为结构化的语义模式，并分配每个词语的重要性权重，构建连续的语义重要性波。手势轨迹通过动态运动基元进行塑造，在增强表达性的同时确保运动学可行性。波前优化阶段实现手势与语音的峰-峰同步，并通过手势持续时间压缩和前向传播解决残余的运动学违规问题。基于五个对话场景的实验评估表明，我们的方法实现了高同步精度，并在客观与主观评价中均优于三个基线方法。WaveSync中的每个组件在生成表达性强、语义有据且符合运动学要求的手势中均发挥着必要作用。代码、资源及视频可于\href{https://github.com/pairs-lab/WaveSync}{WaveSync}获取。

Authors: Thang Tran Viet, Thanh Nguyen Canh, Gia Huy Uong, Phuc Van Dinh, Tan Viet Tuyen Nguyen, Xiem HoangVan, Nak Young Chong

Automated Digital Twin Construction for Highway Scenarios Using LiDAR Point Clouds and OpenStreetMap AutonomousDriving

ASAM OpenDRIVE digital twin LiDAR point cloud OpenStreetMap highway simulation

简要说明：本文提出了一种自动化流程，融合LiDAR点云与OpenStreetMap数据生成地理参考的ASAM OpenDRIVE高速公路地图，实现自动驾驶仿真数字孪生的自动构建，仅需极少人工干预。

TLDR: This paper presents an automated pipeline that fuses LiDAR point clouds with OpenStreetMap data to generate georeferenced ASAM OpenDRIVE maps for highway environments, enabling digital twin construction for autonomous driving simulation with minimal manual intervention.

Abstract: Accurate road environment modeling is fundamental to the simulation and validation of automated driving systems. However, constructing road maps in standardized formats such as ASAM OpenDRIVE from real-world sensor data remains a time-consuming and costly process. Mobile mapping LiDAR captures accurate lane-level geometry but is confined to the driven corridor, while OpenStreetMap (OSM) provides broad road network topology but lacks geometric precision at the lane level. To address this, an automated workflow is proposed to fuse LiDAR point clouds with OSM data to generate georeferenced ASAM OpenDRIVE maps of highway environments, requiring minimal manual intervention. The pipeline reconstructs mainline roads from LiDAR-derived measurements and infers ramp geometry and topology from the OSM road graph, enabling complete highway interchange modeling without full sensor coverage. Experiments demonstrate a mean lateral RMSE of 0.740 m, and the generated maps are directly usable in mainstream simulation platforms including IPG CarMaker and Esmini. These results validate the effectiveness of combining measurement-derived geometry with map-derived topology for automated OpenDRIVE digital twin generation. The project code is available at https://github.com/ftgTUGraz/opendrive-digital-twin-generator

摘要（中文）：精确的道路环境建模是自动驾驶系统仿真与验证的基础。然而，基于真实世界传感器数据构建符合ASAM OpenDRIVE等标准格式的道路地图，仍是一个耗时且成本高昂的过程。移动测绘激光雷达能够获取精确的车道级几何信息，但仅局限于已扫描的行驶走廊；而OpenStreetMap（OSM）虽能提供广阔的道路网络拓扑结构，却缺乏车道级的几何精度。针对这一问题，本文提出了一种自动化工作流程，通过融合激光雷达点云与OSM数据，生成高速公路环境的地理参考ASAM OpenDRIVE地图，且仅需极少的人工干预。该流程利用激光雷达测量数据重构主线道路，并从OSM道路图中推断匝道的几何与拓扑结构，从而在无完整传感器覆盖的情况下实现完整的高速公路互通立交建模。实验结果表明，平均横向均方根误差为0.740米，生成的地图可直接用于IPG CarMaker和Esmini等主流仿真平台。这些结果验证了将测量几何与地图拓扑相结合用于自动生成OpenDRIVE数字孪生的有效性。项目代码详见https://github.com/ftgTUGraz/opendrive-digital-twin-generator。

Authors: Yongqi Zhao, Dong Bi, Paul Kovacevic, Tomislav Mihalj, Martin Schabauer, Johannes Betz, Arno Eichberger

APEX: Adaptive Policy Execution for Precise Manipulation Manipulation

execution gap plug-and-play adaptive policy execution visuomotor policies VLA policies

简要说明：APEX 提出了一种即插即用框架，通过重建动态可行参考并在测试时根据低层状态反馈进行自适应，弥合了高层策略输出与低层控制器之间的执行差距，无需修改策略或控制器。

TLDR: APEX proposes a plug-and-play framework that bridges the execution gap between high-level policy outputs and low-level controller dynamics, reducing tracking error and improving manipulation success without modifying the policy or controller.

Abstract: Modern imitation learning methods, including visuomotor and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies, typically output high-level action references that are executed by low-level controllers. However, the absence of higher-order reference signals, together with the policy's lack of awareness of the underlying low-level control dynamics during training, inevitably induces an execution gap. As a result, realized actions deviate systematically from policy-commanded ones, with a critical impact on precision-sensitive manipulation. Prior work either modifies the policy architecture or the low-level controller, both requiring intrusive changes to the pretrained policy or packaged controller. This raises a natural question: when the policy and controller are both treated as inaccessible black boxes, can we bridge the execution gap? We propose Adaptive Policy Execution (APEX), a plug-and-play framework inserted between the policy and the controller that reconstructs a dynamically feasible reference from policy outputs and adapts at test-time according to low-level state feedback, with a provable convergence guarantee. Extensive empirical studies show that APEX reduces controller-induced tracking error by 41.2% on demonstration replay and improves manipulation success by 4.8--25.8 percentage points across four visuomotor and VLA policy classes.

摘要（中文）：现代模仿学习方法（包括视觉运动策略和视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略）通常输出高层级动作参考，并由底层控制器执行。然而，由于缺乏高阶参考信号，且策略在训练过程中对底层控制动态缺乏感知，不可避免地会导致执行偏差。实际执行的动作会系统性偏离策略指令动作，这对精度敏感型操作产生关键影响。现有工作要么修改策略架构，要么修改底层控制器，两者均需要对预训练策略或封装控制器进行侵入式改动。这自然引发一个问题：当策略和控制器均被视为不可访问的黑箱时，能否弥合执行偏差？我们提出自适应策略执行（APEX）——一种插入在策略与控制器之间的即插即用框架，能根据策略输出重构动态可行的参考信号，并在测试阶段依据底层状态反馈进行自适应调整，且具有可证明的收敛保证。大量实证研究表明，APEX在演示回放中使控制器引发的跟踪误差降低41.2%，并在四类视觉运动策略和VLA策略类上将操作成功率提升4.8至25.8个百分点。

Authors: Mengfei Zhao, Chenxi Jiang, Tuo An, Jindou Jia, Jianfei Yang

Robots that Collaborate: Sequential Asymmetric Imitation for Learning Coupled Robot Policies Manipulation

bimanual mobile manipulation imitation learning multi-robot coordination curriculum learning real-world deployment

简要说明：本文提出序列非对称模仿（SAI），一种单操作员课程学习框架，无需同步双操作员演示即可学习耦合多机器人策略，使两台双臂移动操作机器人通过共享刚性和可变形物体实现协调。

TLDR: This paper introduces Sequential Asymmetric Imitation (SAI), a single-teleoperator curriculum for learning coupled multi-robot policies without synchronized dual-operator demonstrations, enabling two bimanual mobile manipulators to coordinate through shared rigid and deformable objects.

Abstract: Collaborative mobile manipulation requires robots to coordinate with a partially observed partner while physically interacting through shared objects. This is difficult because failures often arise not from poor local skills, but from mistimed waiting, yielding, pulling, releasing, or repositioning. We study this problem with two bimanual mobile manipulators coupled through rigid and deformable objects. We propose Sequential Asymmetric Imitation (SAI), a single-teleoperator curriculum for learning coupled multi-robot behaviors without synchronized dual-operator demonstrations or explicit inter-robot communication. SAI trains Robot A from unilateral demonstrations with a compliant human partner, trains Robot B against the deployed Robot A policy, and then refines Robot A using sparse interventions near coordination failures. This staged process exposes the policies to increasingly realistic partner behaviors, including delay, phase mismatch,insufficient yielding, and interaction conflict. Across real-world dual-robot manipulation tasks, SAI improves task success, phase synchronization, and partner-contingent yielding over independent imitation and curriculum-ablation baselines. These results suggest that physically coupled collaboration can be learned through the structure of the imitation curriculum, rather than through synchronized multi-operator demonstrations or explicit coordination mechanisms.Project page:http://cyc0429.github.io/sai-project-page/

摘要（中文）：协同移动操作要求机器人在通过共享物体进行物理交互的同时，与部分可观测的伙伴进行协调。这一任务的难点在于，失败往往并非源于局部技能的不足，而是来自不合时机的等待、让步、拉扯、释放或重新定位。我们通过两台双臂移动机器人经由刚性和可变形物体耦合的场景来研究该问题。我们提出时序非对称模仿（SAI）——一种单操作员教学课程，用于学习耦合的多机器人行为，无需同步双操作员演示或显式机器人间通信。SAI首先通过与顺从的人类伙伴的单侧演示训练机器人A，然后针对已部署的机器人A策略训练机器人B，最后在协调失败附近通过稀疏干预优化机器人A。这一分阶段过程使策略逐步暴露于更真实的伙伴行为，包括延迟、相位不匹配、让步不足及交互冲突。在真实世界的双机器人操作任务中，相较于独立模仿与课程消融基线，SAI提升了任务成功率、相位同步性以及基于伙伴状态的让步能力。这些结果表明，物理耦合协作可通过模仿课程的结构进行学习，而无需依赖同步多操作员演示或显式协调机制。项目页面：http://cyc0429.github.io/sai-project-page/

Authors: Yincong Chen, Ranpeng Qiu, Zihao Li, Yanan Zhou, Guoqiang Ren, Weiming Zhi

HOLO-MPPI: Multi-Scenario Motion Planning via Hierarchical Policy Optimization AutonomousDriving

motion planning model predictive path integral reinforcement learning world model autonomous driving

简要说明：HOLO-MPPI 结合离线高层策略学习与在线 MPPI 控制，实现多场景运动规划，并在自动驾驶中验证。

TLDR: HOLO-MPPI combines offline high-level policy learning with online MPPI control for multi-scenario motion planning, demonstrated in autonomous driving.

Abstract: Robots deployed in the real world must plan motions across diverse scenarios without per-scenario retuning. End-to-end reinforcement learning (RL) can generalize across scenarios but often becomes brittle under distribution shift, reward misspecification, and stochastic interactions. Model predictive path integral (MPPI) control enables strong real-time refinement without gradients, but its performance depends on a well-shaped sampling prior, while manually designing the priors does not scale to multi-scenario deployment. We present HOLO-MPPI (High-level Offline, Low-level Online MPPI), a multi-scenario motion planning framework that combines high-level policy learning with low-level stochastic optimal control. Offline, we learn a high-level policy that proposes scenario-robust plans in an abstract action space, with a learned world model for online rollout. Online, the policy serves as a data-driven prior generator that parameterizes MPPI's sampling distribution conditioned on the current observation and goal. MPPI then optimizes low-level control sequences around this prior in real time to adapt to local disturbances. We instantiate HOLO-MPPI in autonomous driving by designing an effective high-level action space and tailored model architectures. Our evaluation across diverse driving scenarios shows that HOLO-MPPI improves upon MPPI and end-to-end RL baselines while maintaining real-time control.

Authors: Youngjae Min, Jovin D'sa, Faizan M. Tariq, David Isele, Navid Azizan, Sangjae Bae

RHO: Your Coding Agent is Secretly a Roboticist VLA

Code-as-Policies neurosymbolic policy repositories multi-file code generation robot manipulation LLM-based control

简要说明：RHO 提出了一种训练时范 paradigm，使编码代理搜索多文件策略仓库生成机器人控制代码，无需测试时 LLM 循环，在操作基准上取得了强劲的结果。

TLDR: RHO introduces a training-time paradigm where coding agents search for multi-file policy repositories to generate robot control code without test-time LLM loops, achieving strong results on manipulation benchmarks.

Abstract: Code-as-Policies (CaP) has shown that large language models (LLMs) can write code to solve robotics tasks by composing perception, planning, and control primitives. Recent CaP systems, however, rely on multi-turn code-generation loops at test time, which is often infeasible for real-time robot control. We introduce Robotics Harness Optimization (RHO), a novel paradigm in which tool-enabled coding agents, at training time, propose and search for interpretable, neurosymbolic multi-file policy repositories (Repositories-as-Policies) that compose these primitives rather than a single prompt, function, or file. RHO searches with reflective feedback from environment reward and execution rather than teleoperation demonstrations. It generalizes to perturbed pick-and-place settings like LIBERO-PRO, where OpenVLA scores 0.0% and $π_{0.5}$ averages 12.83%. Using the same low-level primitives, RHO reaches a 45.0% success rate, 2.5x higher than the strongest multi-turn agentic system, and 3.5x higher than $π_{0.5}$. On Robosuite, RHO sets a new state-of-the-art of 70.0%, exceeding the prior multi-turn record of 68.29% using single-turn execution with no corrective LLM code edits at deployment. When an LLM is used in the control loop, as on RAI's O3DE benchmark, RHO optimizes the deployed agent's multi-file harness of prompts, tools, and control code, improving held-out success from 23.5% to 44.3% with 20% less wall-clock time and 27% fewer tool calls.

摘要（中文）：代码即策略（Code-as-Policies, CaP）已证明，大型语言模型（LLM）可通过组合感知、规划与控制原语，编写代码解决机器人任务。然而，现有CaP系统在测试阶段依赖多轮代码生成循环，通常难以满足实时机器人控制需求。我们提出机器人操控优化（Robotics Harness Optimization, RHO）这一新范式：在训练阶段，支持工具调用的编码智能体能够提出并搜索可解释的神经符号多文件策略仓库（仓库即策略，Repositories-as-Policies），而非仅依赖单一提示词、函数或文件，从而组合上述原语。RHO基于环境奖励与执行结果的反射性反馈进行搜索，而非依赖遥操作示范。在LIBERO-PRO等受扰抓取放置场景中，RHO展现出泛化能力——此类场景下OpenVLA得分为0.0%，π₀.₅平均仅为12.83%。使用相同的底层原语，RHO达到45.0%的成功率，比最强的多轮智能体系统高出2.5倍，比π₀.₅高出3.5倍。在Robosuite基准测试中，RHO以70.0%的成功率刷新了先前多轮系统68.29%的最优记录，且部署时仅需单轮执行，无需LLM纠错代码编辑。当LLM用于控制循环时（如RAI的O3DE基准测试），RHO可优化部署智能体的多文件提示词、工具与控制代码集成框架，将保留测试成功率从23.5%提升至44.3%，同时减少20%的物理耗时与27%的工具调用次数。

Authors: Karim Elmaaroufi, Justin Svegliato, Sarunas Kalade, Graham Schelle, Sanjit A. Seshia, Matei Zaharia

Training and Evaluating Diffusion Policies with Long Context Lengths Manipulation

imitation learning diffusion policy long context robotic manipulation UNet+Cross-Attention

简要说明：本文系统研究了扩散策略中长上下文长度对机器人模仿学习的影响，挑战了此前关于简单缩放上下文长度会导致性能脆弱的说法，并提出了一种多长度联合训练算法以提高样本效率。

TLDR: This paper benchmarks the effect of long context lengths in diffusion policies for robotic imitation learning, challenging prior claims that naive scaling is brittle and proposing a multi-length training algorithm to improve sample efficiency.

Abstract: Imitation learning has enabled highly-dexterous robotic manipulation from RGB observations. Policies trained with these methods, however, typically condition robot actions on only a short history of observations. These policies cannot solve tasks that require memory and can get stuck repeatedly executing the same failing motions. In this work, we first benchmark policy performance as context length is incrementally increased from short to long, across a spectrum of tasks with varying local stability and memory requirements, and in multiple data regimes. To our knowledge, this is the first study to investigate context length in imitation learning at this level of detail. Our results challenge prior claims: naively scaling context length is not as brittle as advertised in literature. With an appropriate conditioning method and denoising backbone (UNet+Cross-Attention), single-task policies achieve high success rates on many tasks in the usual data regime even with naive scaling. Next, we propose a training algorithm to jointly train policies at multiple context lengths, further reducing the sample complexity of long-context learning. Finally, we apply our findings to re-evaluate some previously proposed solutions to long-context imitation learning.

摘要（中文）：模仿学习已能够从RGB观测中实现高度灵巧的机器人操作。然而，基于这些方法训练的策略通常仅依赖短时间窗口的历史观测来生成机器人的动作。这类策略无法解决需要记忆能力的任务，且容易反复执行相同的失败动作并陷入停滞。在本研究中，我们首先横跨一系列具有不同局部稳定性和记忆需求的任务，以及多种数据规模下，将策略表现作为上下文长度从短到长逐步增加时的基准测试指标。据我们所知，这是首次在如此精细的层次上探究模仿学习中上下文长度影响的研究。我们的结果挑战了先前的主张：简单放大上下文长度并非如文献所述的那样脆弱。通过恰当的条件化方法与去噪骨干网络（UNet+交叉注意力机制），即使采用简单放大策略，单任务策略在常规数据规模下也能在许多任务上取得高成功率。接着，我们提出了一种联合训练算法，使策略能够在多种上下文长度下协同训练，进一步降低长上下文学习的样本复杂度。最后，我们运用研究发现重新评估了先前提出的几种长上下文模仿学习解决方案。

Authors: Abhinav Agarwal, Adam Wei, Taylan Kargin, Michael Zeng, Cole Becker, Arif Kerem Dayi, Pablo Parrilo, Asuman Ozdaglar, Russ Tedrake

V2P-Manip: Learning Dexterous Manipulation from Monocular Human Videos Manipulation

dexterous manipulation monocular human videos trajectory estimation two-stage refinement policy learning

简要说明：V2P-Manip 提出了一种从单目人类视频中直接学习灵巧操作策略的框架，通过整合3D资产获取、轨迹估计和两阶段精炼过程来保证空间对齐与物理一致性，在多个合成任务上取得超过75%的成功率。

TLDR: V2P-Manip proposes a framework to learn dexterous manipulation policies directly from monocular human videos by integrating 3D asset acquisition, trajectory estimation, and a two-stage refinement process for spatial and physical consistency, achieving over 75% success on synthetic benchmarks.

Abstract: Achieving autonomous robotic dexterous manipulation requires precise, human-like action sequences at scale. As a scalable supplement to costly teleoperation data, extracting trajectories with both visual fidelity and physical plausibility from monocular videos represents a promising frontier in embodied AI. To this end, we introduce V2P-Manip, an efficient framework designed to learn dexterous manipulation policies directly from human demonstration videos. We establish an efficient, integrated pipeline encompassing 3D asset acquisition, trajectory estimation, and dexterous policy learning. To bridge the gap between visual perception and physical constraints, we introduce a two-stage refinement process to enforce spatial alignment and physical consistency. Evaluations on the TACO and OakInk benchmarks demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms previous methods in pose accuracy, adaptability to unstructured environments, and training efficiency. Ultimately, experimental results confirm an average success rate of over 75% across multiple synthetic manipulation tasks and validate the adaptability of the extracted manipulation priors across diverse dexterous hand embodiments.

摘要（中文）：实现自主机器人灵巧操作需要大规模、精确且类人的动作序列。作为高成本遥操作数据的可扩展补充，从单目视频中提取兼具视觉保真度与物理合理性的轨迹，代表了具身智能领域一个充满前景的研究方向。为此，我们提出V2P-Manip——一个直接从人类演示视频中学习灵巧操作策略的高效框架。我们构建了包含三维资产获取、轨迹估计与灵巧策略学习的集成化高效流水线。为弥合视觉感知与物理约束之间的鸿沟，我们引入两阶段优化流程以强制执行空间对齐与物理一致性。在TACO和OakInk基准上的评估表明，我们的方法在姿态精度、对非结构化环境的适应性以及训练效率方面显著优于先前方法。最终，实验结果显示在多个合成操作任务中平均成功率超过75%，并验证了所提取操作先验在不同灵巧手构型间的可迁移性。

Authors: Kaihan Chen, Yanming Shao, Haifeng Ji, Xiaokang Yang, Yao Mu

Is Your Trajectory Displacement Safe in Long-tail? AutonomousDriving

long-tail scenarios planning evaluation threat detection autonomous driving safety verification

简要说明：FluidTest是一个自动驾驶规划评估流程，通过结合成对WebUI标注协议、语义威胁分类与决策图以及三智能体验证系统，检测长尾场景中与安全相关的失败情况。

TLDR: FluidTest is an evaluation pipeline for autonomous driving planning that detects safety-relevant failures in long-tail scenarios by combining a pairwise WebUI annotation protocol, a taxonomy of semantic threats with decision graphs, and a three-agent verification system.

Abstract: Long-tail scenarios remain a major bottleneck for autonomous driving evaluation, even as datasets grow by orders of magnitude. Existing evaluation pipelines are rarely human-aligned, safety-aware, verifiable, and explainable at the same time: closed-loop metrics often saturate among strong planners, while unstructured human ratings can be noisy without a carefully designed protocol. We formulate planning evaluation as additional-threat detection: given a planner trajectory and an expert reference, does the planner's displacement introduce new unsafe driving behavior? We propose FluidTest, an evaluation pipeline with three components: a pairwise WebUI protocol for reliable human annotation; a taxonomy of 32 semantic threats with evidence-grounded decision graphs; and a three-agent verification system with reflection for precision and auditability. Experiments on the WOD-E2E dataset show that FluidTest produces consistent labels among trained annotators and identifies additional threats in 65% of Poutine trajectories and 51% of RAP trajectories. These results show that state-of-the-art planners can still exhibit substantial safety-relevant failures despite high Rater Feedback Scores (RFS) and low Average Displacement Error (ADE). Additional details, guidance, and code are available at https://fluidtest.web.app.

摘要（中文）：长尾场景仍然是自动驾驶评估的主要瓶颈，即使数据集规模增长了几个数量级。现有评估流程很少能同时具备人类对齐、安全感知、可验证和可解释性：闭环指标在强规划器之间常常饱和，而未经精心设计协议的非结构化人工评分则可能充满噪声。我们将规划评估定义为附加威胁检测：给定一个规划器轨迹和一个专家参考轨迹，规划器的位移是否引入了新的不安全驾驶行为？我们提出FluidTest，一个包含三个组件的评估流程：用于可靠人工标注的成对WebUI协议；一个包含32种语义威胁并附有基于证据的决策图分类体系；以及一个具有反思机制的三智能体验证系统，用于确保精度和可审计性。在WOD-E2E数据集上的实验表明，FluidTest能在经过训练的标注者之间产生一致的标签，并在65%的Poutine轨迹和51%的RAP轨迹中识别出附加威胁。这些结果表明，尽管最先进的规划器拥有较高的评分者反馈分数（RFS）和较低的平均位移误差（ADE），但仍可能表现出大量与安全相关的失败。更多细节、指南和代码请访问https://fluidtest.web.app。

FlowMPC: Improving Flow Matching policies with World Models Manipulation

Flow Matching world model MPPI ManiSkill test-time planning

简要说明：本文提出FlowMPC，将流匹配策略与学习到的世界模型结合用于操作任务的测试时规划，相比单独策略取得了更高的成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces FlowMPC, which combines a flow matching policy with a learned world model for test-time planning in manipulation tasks, showing improved success rates over the policy alone.

Abstract: Flow Matching (FM) is a powerful approach for behavior cloning in multimodal action spaces [Jiang et al., 2025], but because it is not trained to directly maximize expected return, there is still room to improve how FM policies act at test time. This work investigates whether a learned world model can improve FM policies by enabling Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) planning over candidate action sequences proposed by the policy. Building on TD-MPC2 [Hansen et al., 2024], I introduce FlowMPC, a framework that combines an imitation-learned FM policy with a learned world model for test-time planning in ManiSkill manipulation tasks [Tao et al., 2025]. Across PickCube and PickSingleYCB, adding the world model improved performance over the FM policy alone, with especially clear gains in end-of-episode success. These results suggest that world-model-based planning can effectively complement flow-based imitation policies without modifying the FM training objective.

摘要（中文）：流匹配（FM）是多模态动作空间中行为克隆的一种强大方法 [Jiang et al., 2025]，但由于其并非直接以最大化期望回报为目标进行训练，因此FM策略在测试阶段的表现仍有改进空间。本研究探究了学习型世界模型能否通过策略生成候选动作序列上的模型预测路径积分（MPPI）规划来提升FM策略的性能。基于TD-MPC2 [Hansen et al., 2024]，本文提出FlowMPC框架，该框架将模仿学习的FM策略与学习型世界模型相结合，用于ManiSkill操作任务中的测试时规划 [Tao et al., 2025]。在PickCube和PickSingleYCB任务上，加入世界模型后的表现优于纯FM策略，尤其在回合末成功率方面提升显著。这些结果表明，在不修改FM训练目标的前提下，基于世界模型的规划能够有效补充基于流的模仿策略。

Authors: Chandon Hamel

ATHENA: Accelerated Multi-Task Heterogeneous Influence Functions for Robot Data Curation VLA

influence functions data curation Vision-Language-Action models Kronecker approximation multi-task imitation learning

简要说明：ATHENA是一个可扩展至十亿参数多任务VLA模型的影响函数框架，用于机器人数据筛选，实现约313倍加速，并仅用50-67%的演示数据即达到全数据性能。

TLDR: ATHENA is an influence function framework that scales to billion-parameter multi-task VLA models for robot data curation, achieving ~313x speedup and matching full-data performance with 50-67% of demonstrations.

Abstract: In robot imitation learning, influence functions provide a principled approach to quantify each demonstration's effect on robot task outcomes, yet scaling them to billion-parameter Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models is limited by computational and multitask bottlenecks. To this end, we propose ATHENA, an influence function framework tailored for multitask VLA data curation at a billion-parameter scale. Concretely, it leverages the Kronecker structure of linear-layer gradients to reduce projection cost, and approximates dense Hessian inversion with a rank-r Random Truncated Approximation, achieving about a 313.4x speedup in influence computation. Furthermore, ATHENA formulates global and local interactive influence to balance data curation across 50 jointly trained tasks. Extensive evaluations on RoboTwin 2.0 and real-robot deployment, covering 9.34 and 6.90 hours of demonstrations, respectively, show that ATHENA matches or exceeds full-data joint fine-tuning using only 50% of demonstrations in simulation and 66.7% of data across six real-robot tasks. Overall, ATHENA demonstrates its effectiveness for data curation in billion-parameter multitask VLA fine-tuning.

摘要（中文）：在机器人模仿学习中，影响函数为量化每个演示对机器人任务结果的影响提供了严谨的方法，但将其扩展至十亿参数规模的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型时，受到计算与多任务瓶颈的制约。为此，我们提出ATHENA——一个专为十亿参数规模的多任务VLA数据整理而设计的影响函数框架。具体而言，该框架利用线性层梯度的Kronecker结构降低投影开销，并通过秩为r的随机截断近似实现稠密海森矩阵求逆，使影响计算速度提升约313.4倍。此外，ATHENA构建了全局与局部交互影响机制，以平衡50个联合训练任务间的数据整理。在RoboTwin 2.0及真实机器人部署中的大量评估——分别涵盖9.34小时和6.90小时的演示数据——表明，ATHENA在模拟环境中仅使用50%的演示数据、在六项真实机器人任务中仅使用66.7%的数据，即可达到或超越全数据联合微调的性能。总体而言，ATHENA验证了其在十亿参数多任务VLA微调中用于数据整理的有效性。

Authors: Tao Xu, Jiaxin Wang, Runhao Zhang, Jiayi Guan, Xianchao Zeng, Weixi Song, Xinyu Zhou, Zhetao Chen, Guang Chen, Yong-Lu Li

EgoPhys: Learning Generalizable Physics Models of Deformable Objects from Egocentric Video Manipulation

deformable object digital twin egocentric video physics prior real-to-sim

简要说明：EgoPhys从自我中心RGB视频中学习可变形物体的可泛化物理先验，无需逐物体测试时优化即可生成数字孪生，辅助机器人规划。

TLDR: EgoPhys learns generalizable physics priors for deformable objects from egocentric RGB video, enabling digital twin generation for downstream robotic planning without per-object test-time optimization.

Abstract: Humans naturally understand object physics through everyday interactions, but faithfully predicting complex deformable dynamics, such as elastic materials and fabrics, remains a major challenge for computer vision and robotics. We present EgoPhys, a framework that constructs deformable physical digital twins from egocentric RGB-only video using generalizable priors. EgoPhys overcomes the limitations of existing methods to enable controllable deformable digital twin generation from egocentric videos by distilling per-object inverse-physics solutions into a compact codebook, enabling prediction of dense spring stiffness fields for unseen objects without per-spring test-time optimization. Trained with generalizable priors from diverse egocentric interactions, EgoPhys outperforms baselines in reconstruction, future prediction, and zero-shot generalization. To support training and evaluation, we curate an egocentric interaction dataset covering diverse deformable objects, scenes, and manipulation styles. We deploy EgoPhys on a real xArm6 robot, demonstrating that a digital twin initialized from a single egocentric human play video can serve as an internal world representation to aid in deformable-object planning, highlighting egocentric RGB observations as a scalable path toward real-to-sim pipelines.

摘要（中文）：人类通过日常交互自然理解物体物理特性，但准确预测弹性材料与织物等复杂形变动力学仍对计算机视觉与机器人学构成重大挑战。我们提出EgoPhys框架，该框架利用可泛化先验知识，仅通过第一人称RGB视频构建可形变物理数字孪生。EgoPhys通过将每个物体的逆物理求解结果蒸馏为紧凑码本，克服现有方法的局限性，实现从第一人称视频生成可控形变数字孪生，无需针对每个弹簧单元进行测试时优化即可预测未见物体的密集弹簧刚度场。基于多样化第一人称交互场景的可泛化先验知识进行训练后，EgoPhys在重建、未来预测及零样本泛化方面均超越基线方法。为支持训练与评估，我们整理了一个覆盖多种可形变物体、场景及操作方式的第一人称交互数据集。我们在真实xArm6机器人上部署EgoPhys，证明从单段第一人称人类操作视频初始化的数字孪生可作为内部世界表征辅助可形变物体规划，凸显第一人称RGB观测作为实现真实到仿真流水线的可扩展路径。

Authors: Hyunjin Kim, Ri-Zhao Qiu, Guangqi Jiang, Xiaolong Wang

Scaling Short-Term Memory of Visuomotor Policies for Long-Horizon Tasks Manipulation

short-term memory visuomotor policy gated attention hierarchical architecture manipulation benchmark

简要说明：PRISM 提出了一种基于 Transformer 的视觉运动策略架构，通过门控注意力与层次化令牌压缩来扩展短期记忆，适用于长时间操控任务，在 ReMemBench 基准上持续优于循环网络和 VLA 基线。

TLDR: PRISM introduces a transformer-based visuomotor policy architecture with gated attention and hierarchical token compression to scale short-term memory for long-horizon manipulation tasks, achieving consistent improvements over recurrent and VLA baselines on the proposed ReMemBench benchmark.

Abstract: Many robotic tasks require short-term memory, whether it's retrieving an object that's no longer visible or turning off an appliance after a set period. Yet, most visuomotor policies trained via imitation learning rely only on immediate sensory input without using past experiences to guide decisions. We present PRISM, a transformer-based architecture for visuomotor policies to effectively use short-term memory via two key components: (i) gated attention, which filters retrieved information to suppress irrelevant details, improving performance by reducing the spurious correlations between the history and current action prediction, (ii) a hierarchical architecture that first compresses local information into compact tokens and then integrates them to capture temporally extended dependencies, improving its compute and memory footprint. Together, these mechanisms enable us to scale short-term memory in visuomotor policies for up to two minutes. To systematically evaluate memory in visuomotor control, we introduce ReMemBench -- a benchmark of eight diverse household manipulation tasks spanning four categories of short-term memory -- designed to foster general memory mechanisms rather than siloed, task-specific solutions. PRISM consistently outperforms prior works, including recurrent architectures, transformers, and their variants -- achieving an absolute improvement of 5%--12% over the strongest baseline. On the RoboCasa and LIBERO benchmarks, it achieves absolute improvements of 11%--15% over its no-memory variant and fine-tuned Vision-Language-Action baselines such as GR00T-N1-3B and OpenVLA, despite not leveraging any large-scale pretraining. Together, PRISM and ReMemBench establish a foundation for developing and evaluating short-term memory-augmented visuomotor policies that scale to long-horizon tasks. Additional materials are available at https://shahrutav.github.io/short-term-memory

摘要（中文）：许多机器人任务需要短期记忆，无论是取回已不可见的物体，还是在设定时间后关闭电器。然而，目前通过模仿学习训练的视觉运动策略大多仅依赖即时感官输入，而未利用过往经验来指导决策。我们提出PRISM——一种基于Transformer的视觉运动策略架构，通过两个关键组件有效利用短期记忆：（i）门控注意力机制，它过滤检索到的信息以抑制无关细节，通过减少历史信息与当前动作预测之间的虚假相关性来提升性能；（ii）层级架构，它首先将局部信息压缩为紧凑令牌，再将其整合以捕捉长时间跨度的依赖关系，从而改善计算与内存占用。这些机制共同使视觉运动策略的短期记忆可扩展至最长两分钟。为系统评估视觉运动控制中的记忆能力，我们引入ReMemBench——一个涵盖四类短期记忆任务的八种多样化家庭操作任务基准测试集——旨在促进通用记忆机制而非孤立、任务特定的解决方案。PRISM持续超越先前工作（包括循环架构、Transformer及其变体），在最强基线上实现5%–12%的绝对提升。在RoboCasa和LIBERO基准测试中，相较于其无记忆变体及GR00T-N1-3B、OpenVLA等微调视觉-语言-动作基线，它取得11%–15%的绝对改进——尽管未利用任何大规模预训练。PRISM与ReMemBench共同为开发与评估可扩展至长时任务的短期记忆增强型视觉运动策略奠定基础。补充材料见 https://shahrutav.github.io/short-term-memory

Authors: Rutav Shah, Rajat Kumar Jenamani, Xiaohan Zhang, Lingfeng Sun, Roberto Martín-Martín, Yuke Zhu, Deva Ramanan, Karl Schmeckpeper

$λ$-Reachability: Geometric-Horizon Safety Bellman Equations for Humanoid Safety HumanoidEmbodied

Hamilton-Jacobi safety analysis temporal-difference learning humanoid robot safety λ-Reachability geometric horizon

简要说明：本文提出λ-Reachability，一种用于Hamilton-Jacobi安全分析的多步时序差分方法，能够改进高维人形机器人的安全值估计与边界分类，并在仿真和真实机器人上得到了验证。

TLDR: This paper introduces λ-Reachability, a multi-step temporal-difference method for Hamilton-Jacobi safety analysis that improves safety value estimation and boundary classification for high-dimensional humanoid robots in both simulation and real-world settings.

Abstract: We introduce $λ$-Reachability, a scalable approach to Hamilton--Jacobi safety analysis for high-dimensional robotic systems. Unlike prior discounted formulations that rely on fixed one-step Bellman updates, $λ$-Reachability employs a stochastic multi-step estimator of the safety value, using a geometrically distributed rollout horizon together with a randomly absorbed terminal. Conceptually analogous to TD($λ$), $λ$-Reachability interpolates between local self-consistency updates and long-horizon max-over-trajectory safety targets via an interpretable horizon-control parameter. Unlike TD($λ$), where the terminal value is always incorporated in learning targets, the terminal safety value in $λ$-Reachability is only used at a probability controlled by parameter $δ$. We formally show that for $δ<1$, the update induces a contraction mapping that allows temporal-difference learning; as $λ\to 1$, the estimator recovers the undiscounted reachability objective. We apply $λ$-Reachability to high-dimensional safety learning problems with both simulated and real humanoid robots under balance and collision avoidance constraints. Experimental results demonstrate that $λ$-Reachability significantly improves both safe-set boundary classification and safety margin estimation compared to single-step temporal-difference baselines.

摘要（中文）：我们提出 $\lambda$-可达性（$\lambda$-Reachability），一种面向高维机器人系统的哈密顿-雅可比安全性分析可扩展方法。与依赖固定一步贝尔曼更新的传统折扣化公式不同，$\lambda$-可达性采用安全值的随机多步估计器，利用几何分布的展开轨迹长度与随机吸收终端。在概念上类似于 TD($\lambda$)，$\lambda$-可达性通过可解释的视界控制参数，在局部自一致性更新与长视界轨迹最大值安全目标之间进行插值。与 TD($\lambda$) 始终将终端值纳入学习目标不同，$\lambda$-可达性中的终端安全值仅在由参数 $\delta$ 控制的概率下使用。我们形式化证明：当 $\delta<1$ 时，该更新诱导出允许时序差分学习的压缩映射；当 $\lambda\to 1$ 时，该估计器恢复无折扣的可达性目标。我们将 $\lambda$-可达性应用于包含平衡与避碰约束的仿真与真实仿人机器人高维安全学习问题。实验结果表明，与单步时序差分基线相比，$\lambda$-可达性显著提升了安全边界分类与安全裕度估计的性能。

Authors: Rui Chen, Shangtao Li, Yifan Sun, Changliu Liu

ARB4WM: An Adversarial Robustness Benchmark for World Models in Continuous Control WorldModel

adversarial robustness world models continuous control Dreamer-style agents visual perturbations

简要说明：一个用于连续控制中世界模型对抗鲁棒性评估的统一基准，测试针对策略、价值和潜在动态的攻击。

TLDR: A unified benchmark for evaluating adversarial robustness of world models in continuous control, testing attacks on policy, value, and latent dynamics across multiple tasks.

Abstract: World models are widely used in robotic and agentic engineering control systems due to their ability to learn latent dynamics for planning and decision-making. As these systems are increasingly deployed in safety-critical settings, understanding their robustness under adversarial conditions has become essential. However, existing evaluations lack a unified benchmark for testing adversarial threats across the policy, value, and latent-dynamics levels of world-model agents. To fill this gap, we present ARB4WM, a unified evaluation framework for pre-deployment robustness and risk assessment of world-model agents under visual perturbations. ARB4WM defines five white-box loss objectives across these three levels and studies their effects when combined with single-step or multi-step perturbation strategies and temporal attack modes, including full-frame, half-sequence, and sparse-frame exposure. Specifically, we evaluate four Dreamer-style agents across 20 tasks from MetaWorld and the DeepMind Control Suite under different loss objectives, perturbation strategies, and temporal attack modes. Results show that attacks targeting value estimation, latent representations, and RSSM dynamics can be as damaging as direct policy disruption, and that early or frequent perturbations are especially harmful, while input-level defenses provide limited recovery under adaptive attacks. These findings suggest that safety, risk, and reliability assessment for world models should cover multiple component-oriented attack objectives and temporal exposure protocols rather than relying solely on action-space robustness. Source code is available at https://github.com/zaoanguai/ARB4WM.

摘要（中文）：世界模型因其能够学习潜在动态以进行规划与决策，被广泛应用于机器人及智能体工程控制系统。随着此类系统在安全关键场景中的部署日益增多，理解其在对抗条件下的鲁棒性变得至关重要。然而，现有评估缺乏统一基准来测试针对世界模型智能体在策略、价值及潜在动态层面的对抗威胁。为填补这一空白，我们提出ARB4WM——一个面向视觉扰动下世界模型智能体部署前鲁棒性与风险评估的统一评估框架。ARB4WM定义了横跨上述三个层次的五种白盒损失目标，并研究了这些目标在结合单步或多步扰动策略以及时间攻击模式（包括全帧、半序列和稀疏帧曝光）时的效果。具体而言，我们针对MetaWorld和DeepMind控制套件中的20个任务，在不同损失目标、扰动策略及时间攻击模式下评估了四种Dreamer风格智能体。结果表明，针对价值估计、潜在表示及RSSM动力学的攻击可能造成与直接策略破坏同等的损害，早期或频繁的扰动尤为有害，而输入级防御在自适应攻击下仅能提供有限的恢复能力。这些发现表明，世界模型的安全性、风险及可靠性评估应涵盖多种面向组件的攻击目标及时间暴露协议，而非仅依赖动作空间鲁棒性。源代码见https://github.com/zaoanguai/ARB4WM。

Authors: Junjian Zhang, Hao Tan, Ruonan Li, Dong Zhu, Aiping Li, Zhaoquan Gu

Kairos: A Native World Model Stack for Physical AI WorldModel

world model physical AI cross-embodiment hybrid linear temporal attention deployment-aware system co-design

简要说明：Kairos 提出了一种为物理AI设计的原生世界模型堆栈，包含基于跨具身数据课程的新颖预训练范式、具有混合线性时间注意力的统一架构以实现长时程状态传播，以及面向部署的系统协同设计以支持高效的真实世界推出。

TLDR: Kairos proposes a native world model stack for Physical AI with a novel pre-training paradigm using a cross-embodiment data curriculum, a unified architecture with hybrid linear temporal attention for long-horizon state propagation, and a deployment-aware system co-design for efficient real-world rollout.

Abstract: World models are transitioning from passive visual generators to foundational, operational infrastructure for Physical AI: they must natively acquire world knowledge from heterogeneous experience, maintain persistent states over long horizons, and execute efficiently within real deployment constraints. We introduce Kairos, a native world model stack designed around these requirements. (1) Kairos learns the world by pioneering a Native Pre-training Paradigm governed by a Cross-Embodiment Data Curriculum, which organizes open-world videos, human behavioral data, and robot interactions into a progressive developmental pathway. (2) Kairos maintains the world by unified world understanding, generation, and prediction within a Native Unified Architecture equipped with Hybrid Linear Temporal Attention, where sliding-window attention captures local dynamics, dilated sliding windows capture mid-range dependencies, and gated linear attention maintains persistent global memory. We establish formal theoretical bounds demonstrating that this temporal factorization strictly limits error accumulation, mathematically guaranteeing state propagation across extended horizons. (3) Kairos runs the world by incorporating a Deployment-Aware System Co-Design to support low-latency rollout generation on server and consumer-grade hardware for real-world observation-action-feedback loops. Experiments on embodied world-model, long-horizon, and action-policy benchmarks show that Kairos achieves top level performance while offering a strong efficiency-capability trade-off. Together, these results position Kairos as a cohesive operational foundation for future self-evolving physical intelligence.

摘要（中文）：世界模型正从被动的视觉生成器转变为具身智能的基础性操作基础设施：它们必须从异构经验中原生获取世界知识，在长时间跨度上维持持久状态，并在实际部署约束下高效执行。我们提出Kairos——一套围绕这些需求设计的原生世界模型栈。（1）Kairos通过开创由跨具身数据课程引导的原生预训练范式来学习世界，该范式将开放世界视频、人类行为数据及机器人交互组织成渐进式发展路径。（2）Kairos通过配备混合线性时序注意力的原生统一架构，以统一的世界理解、生成与预测能力维持世界状态：其中滑动窗口注意力捕捉局部动态，扩张滑动窗口捕捉中程依赖，门控线性注意力维持持久全局记忆。我们建立了形式化理论边界，证明这种时序分解严格限制了误差累积，从数学上保障了跨扩展时序的状态传播。（3）Kairos通过融合部署感知的系统协同设计来运行世界，支持在服务器及消费级硬件上为真实世界的观测-行动-反馈闭环生成低延迟推演。在具身世界模型、长时序及行动策略基准测试上的实验表明，Kairos在实现顶级性能的同时提供了强效的能力-效率权衡。这些成果共同确立了Kairos作为未来自进化具身智能体系统一操作基础的地位。

Authors: Kairos Team, Fei Wang, Shan You, Qiming Zhang, Tao Huang, Zuoyi Fu, Zhisheng Zheng, Yunlong Xi, Feng Lv, Xiaoming Wu, Zeyu Liu, Cong Wan, Pu Li, Ruiqing Yang, Xiaoou Li, Wei Wang, Kangkang Zhu, Yuwei Zhang, Shi Fu, Zheng Zhang, Xiaoning Wu, Xuzeng Fan, Dacheng Tao, Xiaogang Wang

RealityBridge: Bridging Editable 3D Gaussian Splatting Driving Simulations and Real-World Videos AutonomousDriving

Sim-to-Real 3D Gaussian Splatting autonomous driving video restoration temporal consistency

简要说明：RealityBridge是一个Sim-to-Real框架，利用多模态控制和自回归训练来修复和增强编辑后的3DGS驾驶视频，减少伪影并提高时间一致性，用于自动驾驶仿真。

TLDR: RealityBridge is a Sim-to-Real framework that uses multimodal controls and autoregressive training to restore and enhance edited 3DGS driving videos, reducing artifacts and improving temporal consistency for autonomous driving simulation.

Abstract: Long-tail hazardous scenarios are essential for safety-oriented autonomous driving, yet they are difficult to collect and reproduce at scale. Editable 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) simulation offers a promising alternative by reconstructing real driving scenes and supporting controllable scene editing. However, edited 3DGS-rendered videos still suffer from a significant Sim-to-Real gap, including rendering artifacts, degraded foreground assets, inconsistent illumination, and temporal flickering. Existing restoration and video generation methods are insufficient for this task, as they often fail to jointly repair 3DGS-specific artifacts, improve visual realism, and ensure temporal consistency. To fill this gap, we propose RealityBridge, a structure-preserving and asset-aware Sim-to-Real framework for edited 3DGS driving videos. RealityBridge uses multimodal controls, including rendered videos, foreground masks, edge maps, and semantic masks, together with a lightweight GateNet for adaptive condition allocation across backbone layers. We further construct targeted training data and introduce autoregressive long-video training with reward-guided post-training to improve restoration quality, temporal stability, and hallucination suppression. Extensive experiments on internal and public driving datasets show that RealityBridge outperforms existing methods in artifact removal, illumination harmonization, and long-sequence temporal consistency.

摘要（中文）：长尾危险场景对安全导向的自动驾驶至关重要，但其大规模采集与复现存在困难。可编辑三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）仿真通过重建真实驾驶场景并支持可控场景编辑，提供了一种有前景的替代方案。然而，编辑后的3DGS渲染视频仍存在显著的仿真到现实（Sim-to-Real）差异，包括渲染伪影、前景资产退化、光照不一致以及时序闪烁问题。现有修复与视频生成方法难以胜任此任务，因其往往无法同时修复3DGS特有的伪影、提升视觉真实感并确保时序一致性。为填补这一空白，我们提出RealityBridge——一种面向编辑后3DGS驾驶视频的结构保持与资产感知式Sim-to-Real框架。RealityBridge采用多模态控制（包括渲染视频、前景掩膜、边缘图与语义掩膜），并结合轻量级门控网络（GateNet）实现跨骨干网络层的自适应条件分配。我们进一步构建了针对性训练数据，并引入自回归长视频训练与奖励引导的后训练，以提升修复质量、时序稳定性并抑制幻觉。在内部与公开驾驶数据集上的大量实验表明，RealityBridge在伪影去除、光照协调及长序列时序一致性方面均优于现有方法。

Authors: Zhenhua Wu, Yun Pang, Mingkun Chang, Yuwei Ning, Liangzhi Wang, Yi Xiao, Guanbin Li

BadWorld: Adversarial Attacks on World Models WorldModel

adversarial attack visual world model self-supervised velocity attack trajectory-adaptive bi-level optimization control-agnostic perturbation

简要说明：BadWorld 提出了一种无标签对抗攻击框架，针对自回归视觉世界模型，揭示了在不可察觉扰动下模型的严重结构脆弱性。

TLDR: BadWorld introduces a label-free adversarial attack framework targeting autoregressive visual world models, exposing severe structural fragility under imperceptible perturbations.

Abstract: Visual world models (VWMs) synthesize interactive, action-conditioned rollouts from a single context image. However, it remains an open question how robust these models are to adversarial perturbations. Standard adversarial attacks fail to assess this vulnerability because attackers lack ground-truth future videos and cannot predict subsequent user controls. We introduce BadWorld, a label-free adversarial framework tailored for autoregressive VWMs that systematically overcomes both constraints. First, to bypass the need for future supervision, we propose a self-supervised velocity attack that directly disrupts the early denoising dynamics of the model. Second, to ensure the attack generalizes across unpredictable user actions, we formulate a trajectory-adaptive bi-level optimization that actively mines hard control sequences to forge control-agnostic perturbations. Evaluated on representative VWMs with continuous and discrete controls, BadWorld exposes severe structural fragility. Visually indistinguishable adversarial images reliably trigger catastrophic degradation in future rollouts, leading to incomplete denoising, structural collapse, and control inconsistency. These findings reveal critical risks for deploying VWMs in safety-critical systems while highlighting a practical mechanism for privacy protection.

摘要（中文）：视觉世界模型（VWMs）能够从单张上下文图像中合成具有交互特性、受动作条件约束的推演序列。然而，这类模型对对抗性扰动的鲁棒性仍是一个未解难题。标准对抗攻击无法评估此脆弱性，因为攻击者既缺乏真实未来视频，也无法预测后续用户控制指令。我们提出BadWorld——一种专为自回归VWMs设计的无标签对抗框架，系统性地突破了上述双重限制。首先，为规避对未来监督信息的依赖，我们提出了一种自监督速度攻击方法，该方法直接破坏模型早期去噪动力学过程。其次，为确保攻击能够泛化至不可预测的用户行为，我们构建了轨迹自适应双层优化策略，通过主动挖掘困难控制序列来生成与具体控制方式无关的扰动。在采用连续与离散控制的代表性VWMs上进行的评估表明，BadWorld暴露了其严重的结构脆弱性。视觉上无法区分的对抗图像能够可靠地引发未来推演序列的灾难性退化，导致去噪不完整、结构崩溃及控制不一致性。这些发现揭示了将VWMs部署于安全关键系统所面临的重大风险，同时凸显了一种实用的隐私保护机制。

Authors: Linghui Shen, Mingyue Cui, Xingyi Yang

GraphBEV++: Multi-Modal Feature Alignment for Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

BEV perception LiDAR-camera fusion feature misalignment graph matching end-to-end driving

简要说明：GraphBEV++ 通过 LocalAlign-v2 和 GlobalAlign-v2 模块修正激光雷达与相机投影的错位，在噪声条件下实现了领先的检测、占据预测和端到端驾驶性能。

TLDR: GraphBEV++ improves multi-modal BEV perception in autonomous driving by correcting LiDAR-camera projection misalignment with LocalAlign-v2 and GlobalAlign-v2 modules, achieving state-of-the-art detection, occupancy, and end-to-end driving performance under noise.

Abstract: Feature misalignment in BEV perception is a critical yet often overlooked challenge in autonomous driving, especially under calibration uncertainties between LiDAR and camera sensors. To address this issue, we propose a robust multi-modal fusion framework, GraphBEV++, which systematically mitigates projection-induced misalignment. The framework consists of two key modules: LocalAlign-v2 and GlobalAlign-v2. LocalAlign-v2 introduces neighborhood-aware depth features via graph matching to correct local misalignment. It supports both LSS-based and query-based BEV representations, making it compatible with BEVFusion and BEVFormer architectures for consistent cross-paradigm alignment. GlobalAlign-v2 encompasses two variants: Deformable and Diffusion. The Deformable variant addresses global misalignment in LSS-based multi-modal BEV by explicitly learning cross-modal feature offsets. In contrast, the Diffusion variant targets implicit misalignment in query-based BEV by injecting noise to simulate misalignment and employing a denoising process to recover aligned features. Experimental results show that GraphBEV++ achieves state-of-the-art performance under misalignment noise on nuScenes and Waymo subset, improves long-range detection on Argoverse2, and generalizes effectively to the 3D occupancy prediction task, consistently improving occupancy estimation accuracy and robustness under both clean and noisy settings. Furthermore, GraphBEV++ effectively alleviates misalignment issues in end-to-end autonomous driving. Compared with five baselines (UniAD, VAD, FusionAD, MomAD, and WoTE), it demonstrates superior performance in both open-loop (nuScenes) and closed-loop (Bench2Drive and NAVSIM) evaluations across perception, prediction, and planning tasks.

摘要（中文）：BEV感知中的特征错位是自动驾驶中一个关键但常被忽视的挑战，尤其在激光雷达与相机传感器之间存在标定不确定性的情况下。针对该问题，我们提出了一种鲁棒的多模态融合框架GraphBEV++，该系统性地缓解了投影引起的错位。该框架包含两个核心模块：LocalAlign-v2和GlobalAlign-v2。LocalAlign-v2通过图匹配引入邻域感知的深度特征来修正局部错位，同时支持基于LSS和基于查询的BEV表示，使其兼容BEVFusion和BEVFormer架构，实现跨范式的一致性对齐。GlobalAlign-v2包含两个变体：可变形与扩散。可变形变体通过显式学习跨模态特征偏移，解决基于LSS的多模态BEV中的全局错位问题；而扩散变体则针对基于查询的BEV中的隐式错位，通过注入噪声模拟错位，并采用去噪过程恢复对齐特征。实验结果表明，GraphBEV++在nuScenes和Waymo子集上面对错位噪声时达到最先进性能，在Argoverse2上提升了远距离检测能力，并能有效泛化至3D占用预测任务，在干净与含噪场景下均持续提升占用估计精度与鲁棒性。此外，GraphBEV++有效缓解了端到端自动驾驶中的错位问题。与五种基线方法（UniAD、VAD、FusionAD、MomAD和WoTE）相比，其在感知、预测和规划任务的开环（nuScenes）与闭环（Bench2Drive和NAVSIM）评估中均展现出更优性能。
