Authors: Ziying Song, Caiyan Jia, Lin Liu, Shaoqing Xu, Lei Yang, Yadan Luo

GraphWorld: Long-Horizon Planning with World Models for End-to-End Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

world model end-to-end autonomous driving long-horizon planning ego-centric interaction graph safety-aware trajectory planning

简要说明：GraphWorld提出了一个端到端自动驾驶框架，通过学习以自我为中心交互图条件化的潜在世界模型来增强长时域规划，在复杂场景中显著降低碰撞率。

TLDR: GraphWorld introduces an end-to-end autonomous driving framework that enhances long-horizon planning by learning latent world models conditioned on ego-centric interaction graphs, significantly reducing collision rates in complex scenarios.

Abstract: End-to-end autonomous driving has made significant progress by unifying perception, prediction, and planning within a single learning framework, achieving strong performance in short-horizon decision making. However, most existing E2E-AD methods remain confined to short-horizon planning and lack the ability to model long-term temporal dependencies, which severely limits their generalization and security in complex and highly interactive driving scenarios. In this work, we propose GraphWorld, an E2E-AD framework that explicitly enhances long-horizon planning through latent world modeling. We introduce an Ego-Centric Interaction Graph, which adaptively models critical neighboring agents based on spatial proximity, and propagates relational context to planning queries via cross-node cross-attention. We present a World-State-Conditioned Planning that learns ego-centric latent world representations by modeling interactions between an ego vehicle and surrounding agents. This latent world state captures key interaction dynamics and safety-relevant semantics, and serves as a conditioning signal to guide long-horizon, safety-aware trajectory planning. Extensive experiments on Bench2Drive, NAVSIMv1/2, and nuScenes demonstrate that GraphWorld significantly reduces collision rates and improves long-horizon planning performance, validating its effectiveness in complex driving environments.

摘要（中文）：端到端自动驾驶通过在统一学习框架中整合感知、预测和规划，取得了显著进展，并在短时域决策中展现出强劲性能。然而，现有大多数端到端自动驾驶方法仍局限于短时域规划，缺乏对长期时序依赖关系的建模能力，这严重限制了其在复杂、高交互驾驶场景中的泛化性与安全性。为此，本文提出GraphWorld——一种通过潜在世界建模显式增强长时域规划的端到端自动驾驶框架。我们引入以自我为中心的交互图，该图根据空间邻近性自适应建模关键邻域代理，并通过跨节点交叉注意力机制将关系上下文传递至规划查询。我们提出基于世界状态条件的规划方法，通过建模自我车辆与周围代理之间的交互，学习以自我为中心的潜在世界表征。该潜在世界状态捕捉了关键交互动态及安全相关语义，并作为条件信号引导长时域、安全感知的轨迹规划。在Bench2Drive、NAVSIM v1/v2及nuScenes上的大量实验表明，GraphWorld显著降低了碰撞率并提升了长时域规划性能，验证了其在复杂驾驶环境中的有效性。

Authors: Ziying Song, Caiyan Jia, Lin Liu, Lei Yang, Shengkai Zhang, Feiyang Jia, Fengda Zhao, Peiliang Wu, Shaoqing Xu, Chen Lv, Yadan Luo

PointDiffusion: Diffusion-Based Scene Completion in the Point Cloud Domain AutonomousDriving

latent diffusion LiDAR scene completion multi-token VAE ground truth refinement single-step inference

简要说明：提出了一种带交叉注意力池化的多令牌高斯VAE，结合基于锚点的ICP真值精炼流程，实现了面向自动驾驶的单步扩散场景补全模型。

TLDR: Proposes a multi-token Gaussian VAE with cross-attention pooling for stable scene-scale LiDAR compression, combined with an anchor-based ICP ground truth refinement pipeline to enable a single-step diffusion completion model for autonomous driving.

Abstract: Reconstructing dense 3D scenes from sparse LiDAR point clouds is a fundamental challenge in autonomous driving, where latent diffusion models offer a promising solution. However, existing approaches rely on object-level autoencoders that collapse into unstable global representations at outdoor scale and suffer from ground truth data corrupted by odometry drift that systematically degrades supervision quality. Furthermore, multi-step diffusion inference incurs prohibitive latency for real-time deployment. We propose a novel multi-token Gaussian VAE with cross-attention pooling for stable scene-scale LiDAR compression, combined with an anchor-based ICP ground truth refinement pipeline that eliminates drift-induced noise from training supervision. Together, these components enable a scaffold-free single-step diffusion completion model that achieves an approximately 16x reduction in squared Chamfer distance on SemanticKITTI seq. 08 (0.396 m^2 to 0.024 m^2), surpasses LiDiff and ScoreLiDAR by 17-19% and 10-11%, respectively, and operates at 25-143x lower inference latency. Our results demonstrate that data quality dominates model design in this regime and that multi-token latent spaces provide a stable first stage for latent diffusion-based scene completion.

摘要（中文）：从稀疏LiDAR点云重建稠密三维场景是自动驾驶领域的一项基础性挑战，潜在扩散模型为此提供了有前景的解决方案。然而，现有方法依赖目标级自编码器，该编码器在户外尺度下会坍缩为不稳定的全局表征，且受里程计漂移导致的真值数据污染，系统性降低监督质量。此外，多步扩散推理产生的延迟对实时部署而言过高。本文提出一种新型多标记高斯变分自编码器，结合交叉注意力池化实现稳定的场景级LiDAR压缩，并融合基于锚点的ICP真值优化流程，消除训练监督中由漂移引入的噪声。这些组件共同构建了无骨架单步扩散补全模型：在SemanticKITTI序列08上，平方倒角距离从0.396 m²降至0.024 m²（约16倍缩减），分别超越LiDiff与ScoreLiDAR达17-19%与10-11%，推理延迟降低25-143倍。实验结果表明，在此范畴内数据质量主导模型设计，多标记潜在空间为基于潜在扩散的场景补全提供了稳定的第一阶段。

Authors: Chidera Agbasiere, Mikhail Sannikov, Faith Ogunwoye, Erik Shaikhiev, Alex Kozinov, Ilya Mikhalchuk, Iana Zhura, Dzmitry Tsetserukou

R2RDreamer: 3D-aware Data Augmentation for Spatially-generalized 2D Manipulation Policies Manipulation

data augmentation spatial generalization manipulation policy image-to-video model real-to-real

简要说明：R2RDreamer 是一个真实到真实的数据增强框架，通过结合轻量级3D编辑和密集控制图像到视频模型，实现时间连贯的观测补全，从而提升基于2D RGB的操作策略的空间泛化能力。

TLDR: R2RDreamer is a real-to-real data augmentation framework that enhances spatial generalization of 2D RGB-based manipulation policies by combining lightweight 3D editing with a dense-control image-to-video model for temporally coherent observation completion.

Abstract: Spatial generalization is critical for imitation-learned manipulation policies, but achieving it typically requires scaling demonstrations across diverse object poses, robot configurations, and camera viewpoints. Data augmentation from a few source demonstrations offers a practical alternative to costly real-world collection. Simulation-based augmentation can create controllable variation, but requires complex environment and object setup and may introduce a sim-to-real gap. Recent real-to-real methods avoid these issues by jointly editing 3D observations and action trajectories from real demonstrations, yet they still rely on strong 3D scene parsing and geometry completion, and often produce observations tailored to 3D pointcloud policies rather than RGB-based 2D policies. We propose R2RDreamer, a real-to-real demonstration augmentation framework that preserves the geometric consistency of 3D action-observation editing while moving visual completion to 2D video space. Specifically, R2RDreamer first performs lightweight 3D augmentation by editing incomplete object pointclouds and end-effector trajectories in a shared 3D frame; it then projects the edited scene into masked image-space control videos with occlusion-aware reasoning and uses a dense-control image-to-video model to complete temporally coherent RGB observations. Experiments on spatially shifted manipulation tasks with both 2D diffusion-style policies and vision-language-action policies show that R2RDreamer improves spatial generalization from limited source demonstrations, with analyses validating the contributions of 3D editing, occlusion-aware projection, and video completion.

摘要（中文）：空间泛化对于模仿学习的操作策略至关重要，但实现这一目标通常需要在不同物体姿态、机器人配置和相机视角下规模化收集示范数据。来自少量源示范的数据增强为高成本的现实数据采集提供了实用替代方案。基于仿真的增强能产生可控变化，但需要复杂的场景与物体设置，且可能引入模拟-现实差距。近期真实到真实方法通过联合编辑真实示范的3D观测与动作轨迹避免了上述问题，但这些方法仍依赖强3D场景解析与几何补全，且生成的观测通常针对3D点云策略而非基于RGB的2D策略。我们提出R2RDreamer——一种保持3D动作-观测编辑几何一致性同时将视觉补全迁移至2D视频空间的真实到真实示范增强框架。具体而言，R2RDreamer首先在共享3D坐标系中，通过编辑不完整物体点云与末端执行器轨迹执行轻量级3D增强；随后将编辑后的场景投影至具备遮挡感知推理的掩膜图像空间控制视频，并利用密集控制图像到视频模型补全时序连贯的RGB观测。在同时采用2D扩散策略与视觉-语言-动作策略的空间偏移操作任务实验中，R2RDreamer增强了从有限源示范出发的空间泛化能力，分析结果验证了3D编辑、遮挡感知投影与视频补全的贡献。

Authors: Xiuwei Xu, Haowen Sun, Angyuan Ma, Yiwei Zhang, Zhenyu Wu, Xiaofeng Wang, Bingyao Yu, Zheng Zhu, Jie Zhou, Jiwen Lu

Task-Error Residual Learning for Real-Robot Five-Ball Juggling RLRobot

residual learning directional task-error supervision task error model real-robot juggling sample efficiency

简要说明：本文提出了一种使用方向性任务误差监督和任务误差模型的残差学习方法，用于真实机器人抛球任务，在Barrett WAM手臂上实现了稳定的3-5球抛球，并从第二次尝试开始收敛。

TLDR: This paper presents a residual learning method using directional task-error supervision and a task error model for sample-efficient real-robot ball juggling, achieving stable 3-5 ball juggling on Barrett WAM arms with convergence from the second attempt.

Abstract: For residual learning that refines existing behavior, sample efficiency depends on two things: how much information each rollout returns, and how efficiently the learner uses that information. Reinforcement learning's standard scalar reward carries far less information than the directional task error that defines the task. Random exploration further discards whatever information each rollout returns. Through residual learning with directional task-error supervision and a task error model that drives sample selection, we achieve stable three-, four-, and five-ball juggling on anthropomorphic Barrett WAM arms. Despite planning and controlling through a simple, idealized stack, the system converges from the second attempt. The first attempt drops, after which task error decreases monotonically without further failures. In comparison, five-ball juggling typically takes humans years of practice. We compare residual learners across two ternary axes, the directional information in the learning feedback and the commitment of the analytic prior, spanning Newton-style Jacobian updates, Composite Bayesian Optimization, and stochastic search methods. Both axes prove necessary: neither directional feedback nor an informative prior suffices alone, and the simplest method that combines them, a fixed-Jacobian Newton update, is the most reliable. The learned residual tolerates substantial prior misalignment and degraded joint tracking, affecting mainly convergence speed. The bottleneck for residual learning on real robots is therefore the information content of the supervision signal and how the learner uses it, not the accuracy of the surrounding stack. Video documentation of all experiments is available at https://kai-ploeger.com/residual-juggling.

摘要（中文）：对于优化现有行为的残差学习而言，样本效率取决于两个因素：每次轨迹回馈所携带的信息量，以及学习器利用这些信息的效率。强化学习中的标准标量奖励所承载的信息远少于定义任务的方向性任务误差。随机探索则进一步丢弃了每次轨迹回馈的信息。通过采用方向性任务误差监督的残差学习，以及驱动样本选择的任务误差模型，我们实现了在仿人型巴雷特WAM机械臂上稳定的三球、四球和五球杂耍。尽管规划与控制仅依托一个简单、理想化的堆栈，系统从第二次尝试起便收敛。首次尝试失败后，任务误差单调递减且不再出现后续失败。相比之下，人类通常需要数年练习才能掌握五球杂耍。我们沿两个三元轴对残差学习器进行比较：学习反馈中的方向性信息，以及分析先验的承诺程度，涵盖牛顿式雅可比更新、复合贝叶斯优化及随机搜索方法。这两个轴均被证明不可或缺：方向性反馈或信息型先验单独均不充分，而将两者结合的最简单方法——固定雅可比牛顿更新——最为可靠。学习到的残差能够容忍显著的先验失准及退化的关节跟踪，这主要影响收敛速度。因此，真实机器人残差学习的瓶颈在于监督信号的信息含量以及学习器对其的利用方式，而非周围堆栈的精度。所有实验的视频文档见https://kai-ploeger.com/residual-juggling。

Authors: Kai Ploeger, Jan Peters

When Should a Robot Replan? Regret-Guided Update Scheduling in Time-Varying MDPs RLRobot

skip-update scheme dynamic regret time-varying MDP adaptive re-planning budgeted robot control

简要说明：本文研究了计算预算有限的机器人在时变环境中何时重新规划的问题，提出了基于遗憾指导的更新调度规则，并在火星车仿真和真实Crazyflie四旋翼飞行器上进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper studies when a robot with limited compute budget should re-plan in time-varying environments, proposing a regret-guided update scheduling rule for MDPs with drifting dynamics and validating it on a Mars-rover simulation and a real Crazyflie quadrotor.

Abstract: Robots operating in non-stationary environments must continually adapt their policies as the dynamics drift, but onboard energy and compute budgets cap how often a full state estimation and re-planning step can be performed. This raises a question: \emph{when}, along a horizon, should a robot spend its limited budget? We formulate this problem in time-varying Markov decision processes (TVMDPs) with a known bound on the rate of transition drift. We model execution as a \emph{skip-update} scheme in which, at chosen update times, the agent estimates the transition kernel by maximum likelihood and computes a finite-horizon policy, and between updates reuses this policy under a propagated state estimate. We analyze the dynamic regret of this scheme and show how it grows during skip intervals in terms of the properties of the TVMDP and the skip lengths; the resulting bound answers the opening question via an online, regret-guided update rule that allocates the budget adaptively. We evaluate the rule in a simulated Mars-rover navigation task with time-varying slip dynamics and on a Crazyflie quadrotor in indoor obstacle fields. Adaptive allocation outperforms other budgeted baselines.

摘要（中文）：在非平稳环境中运行的机器人必须随动力学漂移持续调整其策略，但机载能量与计算预算限制了完整状态估计与重新规划的执行频率。这引出一个问题：在时间轴上，机器人应何时投入其有限的预算？我们将该问题建模为具有已知转移漂移率边界的时间变化马尔可夫决策过程（TVMDP）。我们将执行过程建模为一种“跳跃-更新”方案：在选定的更新时间点，智能体通过最大似然估计转移核并计算有限时域策略，而在更新间隔间则基于传播的状态估计重复使用该策略。我们分析了该方案的动态遗憾，并根据TVMDP特性与跳跃长度揭示了遗憾在跳跃区间内的增长规律；据此推导的边界通过一种在线、遗憾引导的更新规则回答了初始问题——该规则自适应地分配预算。我们在具有时变滑移动力学模拟的火星车导航任务中及室内障碍物场上的Crazyflie四旋翼飞行器上评估了该规则。自适应分配方案的表现优于其他预算约束基线方法。

Authors: Negin Musavi, Gokul Puthumanaillam, Ruben Hernandez, William Schafer, Melkior Ornik

SidewalkBench: Benchmarking Visual Navigation on Urban Sidewalks VLN

visual navigation sidewalk navigation Isaac Sim simulation pedestrian-reactive scenarios long-horizon robustness

简要说明：SidewalkBench 是一个用于城市人行道导航的高保真仿真基准，能够在行人反应和长周期场景中对视觉导航模型进行标准化评估。

TLDR: SidewalkBench is a high-fidelity simulation benchmark for urban sidewalk navigation, enabling standardized evaluation of visual navigation models under pedestrian-reactive and long-horizon scenarios.

Abstract: Urban sidewalk navigation presents significant challenges due to complex structural layouts, dynamic pedestrian behaviors, and long distances. While recent visual navigation models offer a promising solution, the lack of a unified benchmark hinders quantitative and reproducible evaluation. To bridge this gap, we propose SidewalkBench, a comprehensive benchmark designed for visual navigation on urban sidewalks. Built upon NVIDIA Isaac Sim, SidewalkBench brings GPU-accelerated simulation of diverse, high-fidelity sidewalk environments, including both procedurally generated and real-world scanned scenes. We further populate the scenes with rich, reactive event-based pedestrian behaviors and flexible, efficient animation, enabling standardized model evaluation under realistic real-world settings. We conduct a comprehensive evaluation of 9 visual navigation models on 330 unit-test scenarios, 800 pedestrian-reactive scenarios, and 105 long-horizon scenarios. Our findings highlight that pedestrian interaction and long-horizon robustness remain critical bottlenecks for existing models, and scaling up sidewalk training with synthetic data emerges as a promising solution.

摘要（中文）：城市人行道导航面临复杂结构布局、动态行人行为及长距离行走等显著挑战。尽管近期视觉导航模型提供了有前景的解决方案，但缺乏统一基准阻碍了量化与可重复性评估。为弥补这一空白，我们提出SidewalkBench——面向城市人行道视觉导航的综合基准平台。基于NVIDIA Isaac Sim构建，SidewalkBench实现了多样化、高保真人行道环境的GPU加速模拟，涵盖程序化生成场景与真实世界扫描场景。我们进一步为场景注入基于事件的丰富交互式行人行为，并配备灵活高效的动画系统，从而在逼真的现实环境中实现标准化模型评估。我们针对9个视觉导航模型，在330个单元测试场景、800个行人交互场景及105个长时域场景中开展了全面评估。研究结果表明，行人交互处理与长时域鲁棒性仍是现有模型的关键瓶颈，而利用合成数据扩展人行道训练范式展现出可行前景。

Authors: Zhizheng Liu, Honglin He, Vivek Alumootil, Akshat Pandya, Brad Squicciarini, Wayne Wu, Bolei Zhou

CrossMaps: Confidence-Aware Open-Vocabulary Semantic Mapping for Rover Navigation VLN

open-vocabulary semantic mapping confidence-aware fusion dual-memory architecture CLIP embeddings rover navigation

简要说明：CrossMaps 提出了一种用于巡视器导航的实时、置信度感知的开放词汇语义地图构建流程，结合多尺度 CLIP 嵌入与双记忆架构，在 Jetson Orin 驱动的 UGV 上构建可被自然语言查询的地图。

TLDR: CrossMaps presents a real-time, confidence-aware open-vocabulary semantic mapping pipeline for rover navigation, integrating multi-scale CLIP embeddings with dual-memory architecture to build language-queryable maps on a Jetson Orin-powered UGV.

Abstract: Rovers rely on perception to maintain spatial maps that encode both objects and sensor quality (e.g., range reliability, lighting artifacts, data density), guiding data fusion, embedding updates, and navigation under partial observability. To study these coupled perception-navigation processes, we present CrossMaps, a real-time confidence-aware open-vocabulary semantic mapping pipeline that constructs language-queryable maps from RGB-D data. Building on VLMaps-style approaches, CrossMaps integrates multi-scale CLIP embeddings with confidence-aware fusion and a dual-memory architecture consisting of Short-Term Memory (STM) and Long-Term Memory (LTM). The STM aggregates noisy visual observations using geometric, semantic, and temporal confidence cues, while confident and coherent cells are promoted to the LTM as persistent semantic landmarks. Designed for deployment with a Jetson Orin-powered UGV alongside SLAM, CrossMaps runs in real time and produces semantic heatmaps that can be queried with natural language to guide rover navigation.

摘要（中文）：漫游车依赖感知来维护空间地图，该地图同时编码对象与传感器质量（例如测距可靠性、光照伪影、数据密度），从而在部分可观测条件下指导数据融合、位姿更新与导航。为研究这些感知-导航耦合过程，我们提出了CrossMaps——一种实时、置信度感知的开放词汇语义建图流程，能够从RGB-D数据构建支持语言查询的地图。基于VLMaps风格方法，CrossMaps融合了多尺度CLIP嵌入、置信度感知融合，以及由短期记忆（STM）与长期记忆（LTM）构成的双记忆架构。STM利用几何、语义和时序置信度线索聚合含噪声的视觉观测，而置信度高且一致的空间单元则被提升至LTM，作为持久性的语义地标。针对搭载Jetson Orin的UGV与SLAM协同部署而设计，CrossMaps能够实时运行并生成语义热力图，可通过自然语言查询以引导漫游车的导航。

Authors: Jan-Niklas Klein, Sona Ghahremani, Christian Medeiros Adriano, Holger Giese

Binary Tracking for Spatial QA and Navigation with Open Vision-Language Models VLN

binary search spatial question answering open-source vision-language models quadruped robot trajectory localization

简要说明：BinTrack 是一个完全开源的空间问答系统，通过二分搜索轨迹段来定位查询中的地标，在精度上与闭源 GPT-4o 相当，且可部署于机器人本体。

TLDR: BinTrack is a fully open-source spatial question answering system for service robots that uses binary search over trajectory segments to localize query landmarks, achieving accuracy competitive with closed-source GPT-4o agents while being deployable onboard a robot.

Abstract: This work addresses spatial question answering for service robots traversing long egocentric routes. Given a query such as "where can I find a dry cleaner on the way back home?", the system returns a metric coordinate that downstream navigation components can act on. Prior Spatial Question Answering approaches leverage retrieval-augmented agents built on closed-source models such as GPT-4o for path exploration. However, robots operating in the real world often cannot reliably depend on online closed-source models due to network instability, communication latency, and deployment cost. It creates a need for open-source based Spatial Question Answering approaches that can run onboard the robot, yet prior research in this direction remains limited. This work proposes BinTrack, a simple yet effective, fully open-source spatial-localization agent that leverages the temporal ordering of a robot's trajectory. BinTrack performs a binary search over the trajectory segments between two anchor landmarks identified from a query. It improves overall accuracy by up to 22.8% over other open-source implementations and even matches the reported closed-source model result on the global category of the SpaceLocQA benchmark, the most challenging setting that has so far required strong reasoning agents such as GPT-4o. Furthermore, its optimized inference strategy consistently yields more than a 1.5x inference speedup over previous approaches. Finally, this work releases GangnamLoop, a novel and practical multi-trip outdoor benchmark collected by deploying a real quadruped robot on public streets with the anonymization policy. It revisits the same locations under different outdoor conditions and pairs the robot's low viewpoint with the human owner's. The source codes and datasets are publicly available at https://github.com/ndb796/BinaryTracking

摘要（中文）：这项工作针对服务机器人在长程自我中心路线中的空间问答问题。当收到诸如"回家路上哪里能找到干洗店？"的查询时，系统会返回一个下游导航组件可执行的度量坐标。先前的空间问答方法利用基于GPT-4o等闭源模型构建的检索增强智能体进行路径探索。然而，在现实世界中运行的机器人往往因网络不稳定、通信延迟和部署成本而无法可靠依赖在线闭源模型。这催生了对可在机器人本体运行的开源空间问答方法的需求，但该方向的先前研究仍十分有限。本文提出BinTrack——一种简单高效、完全开源的空间定位智能体，它利用机器人轨迹的时间有序性。该方法在查询识别的两个锚点地标之间的轨迹段上执行二分搜索。相较于其他开源实现，其整体准确率提升高达22.8%，甚至在SpaceLocQA基准测试的全局类别（当前最需GPT-4o等强推理能力的挑战性场景）中达到了闭源模型的报告结果。此外，其优化推理策略相比先前方法始终实现1.5倍以上的推理加速。最终，本研究发布GangnamLoop——通过在实际公共街道部署真实四足机器人并采用匿名化策略采集的新型实用多行程户外基准数据集。该数据集在不同户外条件下重访相同地点，并将机器人的低视角与人类主人的视角进行配对。源代码和数据集已公开于https://github.com/ndb796/BinaryTracking。

Authors: Dongbin Na, Chanwoo Kim, Soonbin Rho, Giyun Choi, Gangbok Lee, Dooyoung Hong

LOPAL: Local Performance-Aware Active Learning from Imperfect Demonstrations Manipulation

active learning learning from demonstration Gaussian Mixture Model shared autonomy imperfect demonstrations

简要说明：LOPAL 通过结合局部性能驱动的高斯混合模型与共享自主控制下的主动数据采集，纠正低质量轨迹段，从而从次优人类示教中提升机器人学习效果。

TLDR: LOPAL improves robot learning from suboptimal human demonstrations by combining a local performance-driven Gaussian Mixture Model with active data acquisition via shared autonomy to correct low-quality trajectory segments.

Abstract: Learning from Demonstration (LfD) enables intuitive robot skill acquisition by allowing robots to learn directly from human task demonstrations. However, current methods often fail to address the fact that due to suboptimal and inconsistent human behavior, the quality of the demonstration can vary within each demonstration. Therefore, we introduce LOPAL (LOcal Performance-aware Active Learning), an active learning approach that leverages this local demonstration quality information. Our approach consists of two synergistic components. First, a local performance-driven LfD method uses a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) to encode both the demonstrated trajectories and their associated local quality assessments. This enables the generation of trajectories that outperform the imperfect demonstrations by utilizing complementary local data of high performance. Second, active data acquisition allows to improve beyond the imperfect demonstrations by collecting additional informative samples. In areas missing good data, the user is actively requested to provide corrections through a shared autonomy (SA) mechanism, while the robot autonomously executes the learned behavior. The efficacy of LOPAL was validated in both a simulation and a real-world experiment. The results from a real-world pipe inspection task showed that the proposed approach can achieve up to 27.31 % improvement in task performance while also reducing the effort required to collect the demonstrations.

摘要（中文）：从演示中学习（LfD）通过使机器人能够直接学习人类任务演示，实现了直观的机器人技能获取。然而，当前的方法通常未能解决因人类行为欠优和不一致而导致的演示质量在每次演示中各不相同的问题。为此，我们提出了LOPAL（局部性能感知主动学习），一种利用局部演示质量信息的主动学习方法。该方法由两个协同组件构成。首先，一种基于局部性能驱动的LfD方法采用高斯混合模型（GMM）来同时编码演示轨迹及其相关的局部质量评估。这使得通过利用高性能的互补局部数据，能够生成优于不完美演示的轨迹。其次，主动数据采集通过收集额外信息丰富的样本，实现了对不完美演示的进一步改进。在缺乏优质数据的区域，系统通过共享自主（SA）机制主动请求用户提供修正，同时机器人自主执行已学行为。LOPAL的有效性在仿真实验和真实世界实验中均得到了验证。真实管道巡检任务的结果表明，所提方法在任务性能上可实现高达27.31%的提升，同时减少了收集演示所需的工作量。

Authors: Johannes Heidersberger, Shail Jadav, Dongheui Lee

ExoTraj: A General Lower-limb Exoskeleton Assistance Policy for Complex Environments Locomotion

exoskeleton trajectory prediction flow matching model predictive control adaptive assistance

简要说明：ExoTraj 提出基于流匹配的轨迹预测和模型预测控制的力矩优化方法，在复杂户外环境下实现自适应下肢外骨骼辅助，降低预测误差和代谢成本。

TLDR: ExoTraj proposes a flow-matching-based trajectory prediction and MPC-based torque optimization to enable adaptive lower-limb exoskeleton assistance in complex outdoor environments, reducing prediction error and metabolic cost.

Abstract: Adaptive torque prediction in dynamic exoskeleton scenarios requires expensive motion capture systems, which are infeasible in complex outdoor environments. Trajectory prediction has emerged as one of the effective approaches to address such an issue. However, the core challenges of exoskeleton trajectory prediction are twofold: establishing the mapping from multi-modal features to trajectory information; constructing the mapping from trajectory to torque. For the former, most existing methods perform only single-step prediction and neglect inter-subject trajectory variability, thereby limiting the trajectory optimization space and prediction generalization. To address this, this paper proposes a fast flow matching method that enables accurate trajectory prediction and better generalization for real-time performance, where trajectory generation errors and encoded observations are used to guide the training direction. For the second challenge, due to the high dynamics of the human-robot system and the strong coupling between perception and control, simple control methods struggle to achieve efficient assistance based on the predicted trajectory. This paper utilizes model predictive control and designs a novel optimization objective to optimize torque, ensuring the exoskeleton achieves comfortable and robust assistance. By integrating the above two components, the unified policy, denoted as ExoTraj, is developed to enable adaptive assistance in complex outdoor scenarios without high data acquisition cost. Experimental results show that compared to traditional methods, ExoTraj reduces cross-subject prediction error by 14.0% during the online phase and maintains robustness against external noise. Relative to the zero torque condition, ExoTraj decreases metabolic rate by 11.5-24.4%, heart rate by 1.7-19.5%, and peak muscle activation levels by 10.9-41.3%, respectively.

摘要（中文）：动态外骨骼场景中的自适应力矩预测需要昂贵的动作捕捉系统，这在复杂户外环境中难以实现。轨迹预测已成为解决该问题的有效方法之一。然而，外骨骼轨迹预测面临双重核心挑战：建立多模态特征到轨迹信息的映射；以及构建轨迹到力矩的映射。针对前者，现有方法大多仅进行单步预测且忽略个体间轨迹差异，从而限制了轨迹优化空间与预测泛化能力。为此，本文提出一种快速流匹配方法，能够实现精确的轨迹预测并增强实时性能的泛化能力，其中轨迹生成误差与编码观测值被用于指导训练方向。针对第二个挑战，由于人机系统的高动态特性以及感知与控制的强耦合性，简单控制方法难以基于预测轨迹实现高效辅助。本文采用模型预测控制并设计新颖的优化目标以优化力矩，确保外骨骼实现舒适且鲁棒的辅助。通过整合上述两个组件，开发了统一策略ExoTraj，使其能够在不具备高数据采集成本的复杂户外场景中实现自适应辅助。实验结果表明，与传统方法相比，ExoTraj在线阶段将跨受试者预测误差降低14.0%，并保持对外部噪声的鲁棒性。相对于零力矩条件，ExoTraj使代谢率降低11.5-24.4%，心率降低1.7-19.5%，峰值肌肉激活水平降低10.9-41.3%。

Authors: Xiao-Yin Liu, Guotao Li, Long Sun, Xu Liang, Zeng-Guang Hou

Video-Based Optimal Transport for Feedback-Efficient Offline Preference-Based Reinforcement Learning Manipulation

Preference-based RL Video Foundation Models Optimal Transport Pseudo-labeling Robotic manipulation

简要说明：VOTP利用最优传输在视频基础模型表示上生成伪标签，用于离线偏好强化学习，从而在极少人工标注下学习有效奖励函数。

TLDR: VOTP uses optimal transport on video foundation model representations to generate pseudo-labels for offline preference-based RL, enabling effective reward learning from very few human labels.

Abstract: Conveying complex objectives to reinforcement learning (RL) agents often requires meticulous reward engineering. Preference-based RL (PbRL) offers a promising alternative by learning reward functions from human feedback, but its scalability is hindered by high labeling costs. Inspired by advances in Video Foundation Models (ViFMs), we present Video-based Optimal Transport Preference (VOTP), a semi-supervised framework that learns effective reward functions from only a handful of labels. By leveraging optimal transport to align visual trajectories within the rich representation space of ViFMs, VOTP effectively generates high-fidelity pseudo-labels for large amounts of unlabeled data, substantially reducing human supervision. Extensive experiments across locomotion and manipulation benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of VOTP, which outperforms state-of-the-art offline PbRL methods under limited feedback budgets. We also showcase the robustness of VOTP in the presence of visual distractors and validate its utility on real robotic tasks, where it learns meaningful rewards with minimal human input.

摘要（中文）：向强化学习（RL）智能体传达复杂目标通常需要精心的奖励设计。基于偏好的强化学习（PbRL）通过从人类反馈中学习奖励函数提供了一种有前景的替代方案，但其可扩展性受到高标注成本的制约。受视频基础模型（ViFMs）进展的启发，我们提出了基于视频的最优传输偏好（VOTP）——一种半监督框架，仅需少量标签即可学习有效的奖励函数。通过利用最优传输在ViFMs丰富的表征空间中对齐视觉轨迹，VOTP能够高效地为大量未标注数据生成高保真伪标签，显著降低了对人工监督的需求。在运动控制与操作基准上的大量实验证明了VOTP的优越性，在有限的反馈预算下，其性能超越了最先进的离线PbRL方法。我们还展示了VOTP在面对视觉干扰时的鲁棒性，并在真实机器人任务中验证了其效用——该框架仅需极少量人工输入即可学习有意义的奖励。

VENOM: Versatile Embodied Network for Omni-bodied Motion tracking HumanoidEmbodied

cross-embodiment motion tracking humanoid robot learning GPT-based model full-body motion tracking multi-humanoid dataset

简要说明：VENOM提出了一种基于GPT的跨本体全身运动跟踪模型，在仿真中针对多种人形机器人，使用自建多机器人数据集训练，无需分离上下身控制。

TLDR: VENOM proposes a GPT-based cross-embodiment full-body motion tracking model for multiple humanoids in simulation, trained on a curated multi-humanoid dataset without splitting upper/lower body control.

Abstract: Achieving expert-level expressive full-body motion tracking across multiple humanoids solely from demonstration data remains a challenging and relatively an underexplored problem in humanoid robot learning. Cross-embodiment motion tracking policies are mostly trained by decoupling the control problem into upper and lower body control. This work proposes VENOM, a cross-embodiment full-body motion tracking model for humanoids in simulation. VENOM is a GPT-based motion tracker trained on multiple humanoid data that can track the entire body without the requirement to split into upper and lower body control. We curate a multi-humanoid motion tracking dataset called the VENOM dataset that contains states, actions, and rewards and train VENOM and the baselines on this dataset. In this letter, we evaluate VENOM's performance against baselines and show that we can achieve a stable motion tracker across different humanoids more capable than an MLP trained on multiple humanoid data with supervised learning alone, and also show that despite lack of reward feedback, VENOM closely matches the tracking capability of experts that were trained using asymmetric-actor critic reinforcement learning.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 仅凭演示数据在多个仿人机器人上实现专家级表现力的全身运动追踪，仍是仿人机器人学习中一个具有挑战性且相对未被充分探索的问题。跨具身运动追踪策略主要通过将控制问题分解为上半身和下半身控制进行训练。本文提出VENOM——一种面向仿真环境中仿人机器人的跨具身全身运动追踪模型。VENOM是基于GPT架构的运动追踪器，在多个仿人机器人数据上训练而成，能够追踪全身运动而无需拆分上下半身控制。我们构建了名为VENOM数据集的多仿人机器人运动追踪数据集，包含状态、动作和奖励信息，并在此数据集上训练VENOM及基线模型。本文通过对比基线模型评估VENOM的性能，结果表明：相比仅通过监督学习在多个仿人机器人数据上训练的MLP模型，我们能够实现更强大的跨仿人机器人稳定运动追踪器；同时，尽管缺乏奖励反馈，VENOM的追踪能力仍接近采用非对称演员-评论家强化学习训练的专家模型。

Authors: Siddharth Padmanabhan, Kazuki Miyazawa, Takato Horii

Towards mm-Level Accurate UWB Radar: High-Accuracy Phase-Based Obstacle Detection through Multi-Channel Fusion VLN

UWB radar phase-based ranging multi-channel fusion obstacle detection robotic perception

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于无源UWB雷达的相位信号处理框架，实现了厘米级障碍物检测精度（中位误差1.69厘米），显著优于传统仅基于幅值的方法，并在金属工业环境中的机器人上验证了其有效性。

TLDR: This paper introduces a novel phase-based signal processing framework for passive UWB radar that achieves centimeter-level obstacle detection accuracy (median error 1.69 cm), significantly outperforming traditional amplitude-only methods, and demonstrates its effectiveness on a robot in a metallic industrial environment.

Abstract: Accurate, tag-free distance estimation with ultrawideband (UWB) radar is essential for applications such as autonomous guided vehicles, robotics, and environment characterization. For tag-based localization systems, phase-based UWB signal processing techniques have demonstrated sub-wavelength ranging precision, but these approaches are not applicable for passive (tagless) radar setups with weak reflections, mixed multipath conditions, and the absence of a known time-of-flight (ToF) first-path reference. This paper demonstrates for the first time that phase information can be effectively exploited in a fully passive UWB radar setting. We introduce a signal processing framework that extracts reliable distance information by combining coarse amplitude-based estimates with high-resolution phase changes across multiple frequency channels. By referencing phase measurements with the line-of-sight component, the method compensates for hardware-induced phase drift, while the use of multichannel frequency diversity enables disambiguation of periodic phase information and improves robustness against frequencyspecific channel degradation such as Fresnel zones. The proposed approach is validated on a robot equipped with a bistatic UWB radar using DW3000 devices and evaluated in a realistic metallic industrial environment. Experimental results show that our work consistently achieves centimeter-level accuracy even at high speeds, with a median error of 1.69 cm, significantly outperforming existing ~10cm accuracy UWB radar approaches relying only on amplitude-information. We further show how multi-channel fusion exploits uncorrelated channel degradation to reduce the error by more than 40% compared to single-channel operation, and outline how phase modeling and fusion can be pushed toward sub-centimeter accuracy.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 利用超宽带（UWB）雷达实现无标签、高精度距离估计，对于自主引导车辆、机器人以及环境特征描述等应用至关重要。在基于标签的定位系统中，基于相位的UWB信号处理技术已展现出亚波长级的测距精度，但这些方法无法适用于无源（无标签）雷达场景——该场景中回波信号微弱、多径条件复杂，且缺乏已知的飞行时间（ToF）首径参考。本文首次证明，在全无源UWB雷达配置下可有效利用相位信息。我们提出一种信号处理框架，通过将基于幅度的粗估计与跨多个频道的相位高分辨率变化相结合，提取可靠的的距离信息。该方法以直视分量作为相位测量基准，补偿硬件引起的相位漂移；同时利用多频道频率分集消除相位周期性模糊，并提升对特定频率的通道退化（如菲涅耳区效应）的鲁棒性。采用搭载双基地UWB雷达（基于DW3000器件）的机器人在真实金属工业环境中完成验证。实验结果显示，即便在高速运动下，该方法仍能稳定实现厘米级精度，中位误差为1.69 cm，显著优于仅依赖幅度信息的现有UWB雷达方案（精度约10 cm）。进一步研究表明，多通道融合通过利用非相关的通道退化，使误差较单通道操作降低40%以上；同时，本文还阐述了如何将相位建模与融合推向亚厘米级精度。

Authors: Jelle De Moerloose, Adnan Shahid, Eli De Poorter

Reinforcement Learning with Inner-loop Dynamics Estimator for Aerial Manipulation under Uncertainty Manipulation

aerial manipulation reinforcement learning dynamics estimator hierarchical control robustness

简要说明：提出了一种结合强化学习外环与内环动力学估计器的分层控制框架，用于在负载和动态不确定下实现精确的空中操作，在真实四旋翼机械臂上验证。

TLDR: A hierarchical control framework combining an RL outer loop with an inner-loop dynamics estimator for precise aerial manipulation under payload and dynamic uncertainty, validated on a real quadrotor with a 3-DoF arm.

Abstract: Aerial manipulators enable physical interaction in hard-to-reach environments; however, the combined problem of direct whole-body aerial manipulation under rapid arm motion, payload changes, and related unknown dynamic uncertainty remains a largely unsolved problem. We present a hierarchical control framework that combines Reinforcement Learning (RL) with an inner-loop dynamics estimator to address this problem. The RL outer loop maps desired 6-degrees-of-freedom (DOF) end-effector targets to coordinated whole-body commands, enabling direct task-driven control without relying on a fully accurate coupled dynamic model in the policy layer. An inner loop then tracks these commands while compensating for transient inertial shifts and uncertainty during execution via a dynamics estimator scheme without requiring system model knowledge. We validate the proposed approach on a custom quadrotor equipped with a 3-DoF manipulator through hardware experiments under varying payload conditions. Compared with RL+PID and RL+INDI+PID baselines, the proposed method reduces end-effector tracking error and improves task success rate across the tested hardware conditions. These results show that combining learned whole-body coordination with estimator-based low-level compensation improves the precision and robustness of aerial manipulation under changing operating conditions.

摘要（中文）：空中操作器能够在难以抵达的环境中实现物理交互；然而，在快速臂部运动、负载变化及相关的未知动态不确定性条件下，直接进行全身空中操作的综合问题仍是一个尚未得到充分解决的难题。我们提出了一种分层控制框架，将强化学习与内环动态估计器相结合以应对这一挑战。强化学习外环将期望的六自由度末端执行器目标映射为协调的全身指令，从而在策略层无需依赖完全精确的耦合动态模型即可实现直接任务驱动控制。随后，内环在跟踪这些指令的同时，通过无需系统模型知识的动态估计器方案，补偿执行过程中的瞬态惯性偏移与不确定性。我们在配备三自由度机械臂的定制四旋翼飞行器上，通过不同负载条件下的硬件实验验证了所提方法。与RL+PID和RL+INDI+PID基线相比，所提方法在各类硬件测试条件下均降低了末端执行器跟踪误差，并提升了任务成功率。这些结果表明，将学习的全身协调能力与基于估计器的底层补偿相结合，可提升空中操作在变化工况下的精度与鲁棒性。

Authors: Shivansh Pratap Singh, Samaksh Ujjwal, Ishita Chaudhary, V R Vasudevan, Rishabh Dev Yadav, Spandan Roy

Steering Generative Reinforcement Learning into Stable Robotic Controller RLRobot

generative policy latent-space RL deterministic controller locomotion diffusion policies

简要说明：提出SteerGenPO，一个潜在空间强化学习框架，将训练好的生成式（扩散/流基）随机策略转化为确定性控制器，以实现稳定机器人控制，在Isaac Lab和Unitree G1运动任务上进行了评估。

TLDR: Proposes SteerGenPO, a latent-space RL framework that converts a trained generative (diffusion/flow-based) stochastic policy into a deterministic controller for stable robotic control, evaluated on Isaac Lab and Unitree G1 locomotion tasks.

Abstract: Diffusion and flow-based generative policies provide a powerful policy class for reinforcement learning by inducing rich stochastic exploration through iterative action generation. However, the stochasticity of diffusion policies is not suitable for stable and precise control in high-dimensional robotic systems, where small action variations can accumulate into inconsistent motion and reduced robustness. To address this issue, we propose SteerGenPO, a latent-space reinforcement learning framework that steers a trained generative policy into a robust deterministic robotic controller. The key idea is to replace stochastic latent sampling of the trained generative policy with a learned latent actor that predicts a state-dependent latent input for the generative policies. This separates exploration and control: stochastic generative sampling provides diverse action proposals during policy learning, while deterministic latent steering provides stable and adaptive control at deployment. We evaluate SteerGenPO on six Isaac Lab benchmarks and a Unitree G1 locomotion task. The results show SteerGenPO improves over both classical RL and generative RL baselines, while its deterministic latent steering produces more stable inference-time behaviors and more reliable command responses.

摘要（中文）：基于扩散与流的生成式策略通过迭代动作生成诱导丰富的随机探索，为强化学习提供了一类强大的策略框架。然而，扩散策略的随机性并不适用于高维机器人系统的稳定精确控制——在该类系统中，微小的动作变化可能累积为不一致的运动并降低鲁棒性。为解决该问题，我们提出SteerGenPO，一种隐空间强化学习框架，可将训练完成的生成式策略引导为鲁棒的确定性机器人控制器。其核心思想在于：用学习得到的隐变量作用者替代训练后生成式策略的随机隐变量采样，该作用者为生成式策略预测依赖状态的隐变量输入。这一设计实现了探索与控制的分离：训练阶段，随机生成式采样提供多样化的动作提案；部署阶段，确定性隐变量引导提供稳定自适应的控制。我们在六个Isaac Lab基准测试及一个Unitree G1运动控制任务上评估了SteerGenPO。结果表明，SteerGenPO相比经典强化学习与生成式强化学习基线均有提升，且其确定性隐变量引导产生了更稳定的推理时行为与更可靠的指令响应。

Authors: Yixuan Wang, Shutong Ding, Ke Hu, Tianxiang Gui, Jingya Wang, Ye Shi

ROSA-RL: Uncertainty-Aware Roundabout Optimized Speed Advisory with Reinforcement Learning AutonomousDriving

reinforcement learning roundabout uncertainty-aware speed advisory Transformer

简要说明：ROSA-RL利用基于Transformer的概率冲突预测器来增强RL智能体的状态，实现不确定性感知的环岛速度建议，在混合交通中实现更安全、更高效的进入。

TLDR: ROSA-RL uses a Transformer-based probabilistic conflict forecaster to augment an RL agent's state for uncertainty-aware speed advisory at roundabouts, achieving safer and more efficient entry in mixed traffic.

Abstract: Roundabouts challenge automated driving in mixed traffic, as heterogeneous and non-deterministic human behavior, unknown driving intentions, and high interaction complexity create uncertainty about whether the conflict zone will be blocked or available at the moment of entry. We present ROSA-RL -- uncertainty-aware Roundabout Optimized Speed Advisory with Reinforcement Learning. It enables safe and efficient roundabout entry for automated and human-driven vehicles in mixed traffic through probabilistic conflict forecasting. A Transformer-based model predicts conflict zone occupancy over a five-second horizon, capturing multi-agent interactions to anticipate upcoming conflicts and available gaps. The prediction outputs encode uncertainty in future motion and intent, and augment the state of a classical RL framework, enabling uncertainty-aware speed coordination. Evaluated in simulations grounded in real-world data, ROSA-RL can effectively handle uncertainty and outperform a comparable model-based baseline, closing the gap to an ideal setting assuming fully known occupancy while improving traffic efficiency and safety. The source code of this work is available under: github.com/urbanAIthi/ROSA-RL.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 环岛在混合交通中给自动驾驶带来了挑战，因为人类行为的异质性与非确定性、未知的驾驶意图以及高度的交互复杂性，使得在进入环岛时冲突区域是否会被阻塞或可用充满不确定性。我们提出ROSA-RL——一种基于强化学习、具备不确定性感知能力的环岛优化速度建议系统。该系统通过概率性冲突预测，使自动驾驶车辆与人类驾驶车辆能够在混合交通中安全高效地进入环岛。基于Transformer的模型可在五秒时间范围内预测冲突区域占用情况，捕捉多智能体交互以预判即将出现的冲突与可用间隙。预测输出编码了未来运动与意图中的不确定性，并增强经典强化学习框架的状态，从而实现不确定性感知的速度协调。在基于真实世界数据的仿真评估中，ROSA-RL能够有效处理不确定性，并优于可比较的基于模型的基线方法，缩小了与假设完全已知占用情况的理想场景之间的差距，同时提升了交通效率与安全性。本工作的源代码可在以下地址获取：github.com/urbanAIthi/ROSA-RL。

Authors: Anna-Lena Schlamp, Jeremias Gerner, Klaus Bogenberger, Werner Huber, Stefanie Schmidtner

ADAPT: Analytical Disturbance-Aware Policy Training for Humanoid Locomotion HumanoidEmbodied

disturbance observer humanoid locomotion analytical disturbance-aware policy force-interactive tasks out-of-distribution robustness

简要说明：ADAPT 提出了一种解析式全身扰动观测器，无需传感器即可在线估计外部力/力矩，并将其输入人形行走策略，从而在扰动和非对称负载下增强鲁棒性和跟踪性能。

TLDR: ADAPT introduces an analytical whole-body disturbance observer that estimates external forces/torques online without sensors, feeding them into a humanoid locomotion policy for improved robustness and tracking under perturbations and asymmetric loads.

Abstract: Humanoids deployed in human-centered environments must handle force-interactive tasks, where external contacts introduce unexpected disturbances that disrupt locomotion accuracy and stability. Existing learning-based approaches rely on broad domain randomization, task-specific force objectives, or learning-based force estimators from motion history, each of which compromises accuracy, task transferability, or out-of-distribution (OOD) robustness. We present Analytical Disturbance-Aware Policy Training (ADAPT), a framework that equips humanoid policies with a physically grounded disturbance observer. The core of ADAPT is an analytical whole-body disturbance observer that estimates residual force/torque online with the accessible robot dynamics, without requiring force/torque sensors. Fed directly into the policy, the estimated disturbances give the humanoid an explicit, physics-derived sense of external force/torque that can generalize across diverse unseen scenes. Experiments on a Unitree G1 humanoid show that ADAPT achieves accurate disturbance prediction and stronger robustness than a proprioception-only baseline under torso perturbations, standing pushes, and asymmetric hand payloads, with improved velocity tracking even on OOD disturbances. Moreover, ADAPT enables penalizing inferred disturbances at lower-body joints to encourage lighter locomotion.

摘要（中文）：人类在人类中心环境中执行任务时，必须处理力交互操作。外部接触会引入意外扰动，破坏运动精度与稳定性。现有基于学习的方法依赖广泛域随机化、特定任务力目标或基于运动历史的学习型力估计器，这些方法均会牺牲精度、任务可迁移性或分布外鲁棒性。我们提出分析型扰动感知策略训练（ADAPT）框架，该框架为类人机器人策略配备物理基础的扰动观测器。ADAPT的核心是一个分析型全身扰动观测器，无需力/力矩传感器即可利用可获取的机器人动力学在线估计残余力/力矩。将估计的扰动直接输入策略，使类人机器人获得基于物理的外力/力矩感知，该感知可泛化至各类未见场景。在宇树G1类人机器人上的实验表明：在躯干扰动、站立推挤及非对称手部负载场景下，ADAPT相比仅依赖本体感知的基线方法实现了更精确的扰动预测与更强的鲁棒性，即使在分布外扰动下也能提升速度跟踪性能。此外，ADAPT可通过对下肢关节的推断扰动施加惩罚，促进更轻便的运动模式。

Authors: Bofan Lyu, Jindou Jia, Kuangji Zuo, Yanshuo Lu, Shijia Han, Gen Li, Boyu Ma, Jingliang Li, Geng Li, Jianfei Yang

Agile Fall Recovery for Quadrotors with Bidirectional Thrust via Reinforcement Learning RLRobot

reinforcement learning fall recovery quadrotor sim-to-real onboard sensing

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于强化学习的四旋翼无人机自主跌倒恢复框架，仅使用轻量级机载传感器即可从任意地面姿态恢复至稳定悬停，并实现了零样本迁移到真实机器人。

TLDR: This paper presents a reinforcement learning framework for quadrotors to recover from arbitrary ground attitudes to stable hover using only lightweight onboard sensors, with zero-shot transfer to real robots.

Abstract: Autonomous fall recovery is a critical capability for quadrotors operating in real-world environments, where collisions or failures may leave the vehicle resting on the ground in an arbitrary attitude. This problem is challenging because recovery must be achieved under limited onboard sensing, in constrained free space, with ground contact, and in the presence of unknown disturbances. In this letter, we present an RL-based framework for autonomous fall recovery of a quadrotor from arbitrary ground attitudes to stable hover using only lightweight onboard sensors. To address severe partial observability and intermittent sensor invalidity, we train a recurrent policy within an asymmetric actor--critic architecture, leveraging an Incremental Nonlinear Dynamic Inversion (INDI) controller to track the policy output. Combined with high-fidelity simulations of motor response and optical flow, the overall training framework significantly reduces the sim-to-real gap. Simulation ablation studies validate the importance of the main design choices, while real-world experiments demonstrate zero-shot transfer and robust recovery under different initial attitudes, wind disturbances, and additional payloads. These results demonstrate that agile quadrotor fall recovery can be achieved without explicit state estimation using only limited and unreliable onboard sensing.

摘要（中文）：自主坠落恢复是四旋翼飞行器在真实环境中运行的关键能力，当发生碰撞或故障时，飞行器可能以任意姿态停落于地面。该问题具有挑战性，因为恢复过程必须在机载传感器有限、自由空间受限、存在地面接触以及未知干扰的情况下实现。本文提出一种基于强化学习的四旋翼飞行器自主坠落恢复框架，仅使用轻量级机载传感器即可使飞行器从任意地面姿态恢复至稳定悬停。针对严重的部分可观测性与传感器间歇性失效问题，我们在非对称Actor-Critic架构中训练循环策略，并利用增量非线性动态反演（INDI）控制器跟踪策略输出。结合电机响应与光流的高保真仿真，整体训练框架显著缩小了仿真与现实的差距。仿真消融实验验证了主要设计选择的重要性，而真实世界实验则证明了零样本迁移能力，以及在不同初始姿态、风扰和额外载荷下的鲁棒恢复性能。这些结果表明，无需显式状态估计，仅利用有限且不可靠的机载传感即可实现敏捷四旋翼飞行器的坠落恢复。

Authors: Anke Zhao, Yuhang Zhong, Kenghou Hoi, Junyu Mou, Junjie Wang, Lijie Wang, Jialiang Hou, Fei Gao

HATS: A Human-Agent Teleoperation System for Multi-Arm Data Collection Manipulation

multi-arm teleoperation human-agent collaboration MLLM-based agent data collection manipulation policy

简要说明：HATS 是一种人机协作遥操作系统，单个人类操作员直接控制两只机械臂，同时基于多模态大模型的智能体自主控制两只辅助臂，实现高效的多臂数据采集以用于下游策略学习。

TLDR: HATS is a teleoperation system where a single human directly controls two robotic arms while an MLLM-based agent autonomously handles two assistive arms, enabling efficient multi-arm data collection for downstream policy learning.

Abstract: Many real-world manipulation scenarios, such as handling complex collaborative tasks and dealing with large workspaces, require coordination of more than two robotic arms. Consequently, an effective multi-arm teleoperation system is required to collect demonstrations for training coordinated multi-arm manipulation policies. However, existing teleoperation frameworks mainly focus on single-operator or multi-operator setups, facing a practical trade-off between the cognitive load placed on a single operator and the coordination cost incurred by multiple operators. To address this problem, we introduce HATS, a human-agent teleoperation system that enables a single human operator, assisted by an MLLM-based agent, to collect data for multi-arm manipulation tasks. Our system decouples the control space: two primary arms are directly teleoperated by the human, while two assistive arms are controlled by a training-free agent that handles sub-tasks. In addition, the human operator can use voice commands to prevent collisions and correct assistive arm behaviors during execution. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that HATS achieves data collection efficiency and success rates comparable to expert dual-human teams. Moreover, downstream policy evaluations demonstrate the efficacy and quality of the data collected through HATS.

摘要（中文）：许多真实世界的操作场景，例如处理复杂的协作任务和应对大工作空间，都需要协调两个以上机械臂。因此，需要一种有效的多臂遥操作系统来收集演示数据，以训练协调的多臂操作策略。然而，现有的遥操作框架主要关注单操作员或多操作员设置，面临着单操作员认知负荷与多操作员协调成本之间的实际权衡。为解决这一问题，我们提出了HATS——一种人机协同遥操作系统，使单个操作员能够在基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的智能体辅助下，收集多臂操作任务的数据。我们的系统将控制空间解耦：两个主臂由人类直接遥操作，而两个辅助臂则由一个无需训练的智能体控制，负责处理子任务。此外，操作员可在执行过程中通过语音指令防止碰撞并纠正辅助臂的行为。大量评估表明，HATS在数据收集效率和成功率方面可与专家双人团队相媲美。同时，下游策略评估验证了通过HATS收集的数据的有效性和质量。

Authors: Zesen Lin, Jian-Jian Jiang, Haoming Cen, Xiao-Ming Wu, Dandan Zhang, Wei-Shi Zheng

Decoupled Object-Centric Video Understanding for Generating Robotic Manipulation Commands Manipulation

object-centric video understanding Temporal Shift Modules Object Selection Vision-Language Models

简要说明：一种解耦的以对象为中心的视频理解框架，将动作识别与对象识别分离，以从视频演示中生成精确的机器人操作指令。

TLDR: A decoupled object-centric video understanding framework that separates action recognition from object identification to generate precise robotic manipulation commands from video demonstrations, evaluated on a modified Something-Something V2 dataset.

Abstract: Translating video demonstrations into executable robot commands remains challenging because existing methods often fail to identify which objects are functionally involved in the demonstrated action. As a result, they may generate commands that are linguistically plausible but operationally ambiguous. We propose an object-centric video understanding framework that decouples action recognition from object identification to generate precise, grammar-free manipulation commands. Our approach integrates Temporal Shift Modules (TSM) for efficient spatio-temporal action classification with a novel \textbf{Object Selection} algorithm that identifies task-relevant objects through trajectory-based role classification, blur detection, and overlap minimization. The selected objects are then processed by Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for robust category recognition and zero-shot generalization. Evaluated on a modified Something-Something V2 dataset, our method achieves 86.79\% action classification accuracy and BLEU-4 scores of 0.337 on standard objects and 0.261 on novel objects. These results improve over the strongest task-specific baseline by 80.2\% and 143.9\%, respectively. Larger gains are observed in METEOR and CIDEr, reaching 157.9\% and 171.7\% on novel objects. Across all semantic metrics, our approach consistently outperforms task-specific methods and remains competitive with, or surpasses, large general-purpose VLMs while retaining a modular, object-centric design.

摘要（中文）：将视频演示转化为可执行机器人命令仍具挑战性，因为现有方法常无法识别演示动作中涉及的功能性对象，导致生成的命令虽语言上合理却操作模糊。我们提出一种以对象为中心的视频理解框架，将动作识别与对象识别解耦，从而生成精确的无语法操控命令。该方法融合时序移位模块（TSM）实现高效时空动作分类，并设计新型**对象选择**算法：通过基于轨迹的角色分类、模糊检测与重叠最小化来识别任务相关对象。所选对象随后经视觉语言模型（VLM）处理，实现鲁棒的类别识别与零样本泛化。在改进版Something-Something V2数据集上的评估表明，本方法达到86.79%的动作分类准确率，在标准对象与新型对象上的BLEU-4得分分别为0.337和0.261，较最强任务特定基线分别提升80.2%和143.9%。在METEOR与CIDEr指标上增幅更大，新型对象上分别达157.9%和171.7%。所有语义指标中，本方法一致优于任务特定方法，且在与大型通用VLM保持竞争力或超越的同时，保留了模块化、以对象为中心的设计特性。

Authors: Thanh Nguyen Canh, Thanh-Tuan Tran, Haolan Zhang, Ziyan Gao, Xiem HoangVan, Nak Young Chong

An Augmented Reality Brain-Robot Interface for Generalist Robot Arm Manipulation Manipulation

augmented reality brain-robot interface EEG shared autonomy robot arm manipulation

简要说明：提出了一种结合凝视目标选择与运动想象控制的增强现实脑机接口，用于通用机器人手臂操作，并通过日常任务的用户研究验证了其可行性。

TLDR: Presents an augmented reality brain-robot interface combining gaze-based object selection with motor imagery control for generalist robot arm manipulation, demonstrated through a user study on daily living tasks.

Abstract: The integration of augmented reality (AR) and EEG-based brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) offers a promising path for enabling intuitive control of robots for assistive purposes. However, existing AR brain-robot interface (BRI) systems are often constrained to task-specific structures, limiting their utility in real-world environments. We present an AR BRI designed for generalist robot arm manipulation that combines gaze-based object selection with motor imagery action control. Our system uses eye-tracking for intuitive object targeting and context-aware visual overlays ("Place" and "Use") to guide the user through tasks within a shared autonomy framework. We evaluated the interface through a feasibility study with 18 healthy participants performing three multi-step activities of daily living: drinking, using a drawer, and operating an oven. Our results demonstrate that this interaction paradigm enables effective sequential task execution and high user engagement, achieving a "Good" usability rating (SUS > 70). These findings support the feasibility of the proposed interaction paradigm for complex BCI-driven robotic assistance, and motivate future evaluation with the intended target population. Project website: https://ar-bri-manip.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：增强现实（AR）与基于脑电图（EEG）的脑机接口（BCIs）的融合，为实现面向辅助用途的机器人直觉控制开辟了有前景的路径。然而，现有AR脑机接口（BRI）系统通常局限于特定任务结构，限制了其在真实环境中的实用性。本文提出一种面向通用机器人手臂操控的AR BRI系统，将基于注视的目标选择与运动想象动作控制相结合。该系统利用眼动追踪实现直觉目标定位，并通过情境感知视觉覆盖层（"放置"与"使用"）在共享自主框架内引导用户完成任务。我们通过一项可行性研究评估该界面，18名健康参与者完成了三项多步骤日常生活活动：饮水、使用抽屉及操作烤箱。结果表明，该交互范式能够实现有效的顺序任务执行及高用户参与度，可用性评级达到"良好"（SUS > 70）。这些发现支持了所提交互范式在面向复杂BCI驱动的机器人辅助中的可行性，并为未来在目标人群中的评估提供了动机。项目网站：https://ar-bri-manip.github.io/。

Authors: Shangkai Zhang, Rousslan Fernand Julien Dossa, Luca Nunziante, Marina Di Vincenzo, Kai Arulkumaran

SemGeoNav:A Safety-Guided Visual Navigation Approach with Semantic Reasoning and Geometric Planning RLRobot

visual navigation semantic reasoning geometric planning obstacle avoidance quadruped robot

简要说明：SemGeoNav 是一种分层视觉导航框架，结合了端到端模型的高级语义推理与几何规划的安全避障能力，并在真实四足机器人上验证。

TLDR: SemGeoNav is a hierarchical visual navigation framework that combines high-level semantic reasoning from end-to-end models with geometric planning for safe obstacle avoidance, validated on a real quadruped robot.

Abstract: Learning-based visual navigation has enhanced semantic goal-reaching capabilities. However, due to their black-box nature, purely end-to-end models often lack explicit geometric constraints, leading to unpredictable and unreliable obstacle avoidance in open environments. Conversely, traditional geometric planners ensure safety but struggle with high-dimensional visual targets. To address these limitations, we propose SemGeoNav, a novel hierarchical visual navigation framework.It tightly integrates the high-level semantic reasoning of end-to-end models with the reliable local planning ability of geometry-based methods, achieving robust image-based navigation while significantly improving obstacle avoidance. Furthermore, we introduce a temporal trajectory smoothing mechanism to ensure continuous and stable robot motion. We evaluated SemGeoNav on a Unitree Go2 quadruped robot in real-world environments. The results demonstrate that SemGeoNav outperforms existing representative methods, including ViNT and NoMaD, achieving higher success rates and shorter navigation times.

摘要（中文）：基于学习的视觉导航增强了语义目标到达能力。然而，由于端到端模型的黑箱特性，其往往缺乏显式的几何约束，导致在开放环境中避障行为不可预测且不可靠。相比之下，传统几何规划方法虽能保障安全性，却难以处理高维视觉目标。针对上述局限，我们提出SemGeoNav——一种新颖的分层视觉导航框架。该框架将端到端模型的高层语义推理能力与基于几何方法的可靠局部规划能力紧密融合，在实现鲁棒图像导航的同时显著提升避障性能。此外，我们引入时序轨迹平滑机制以确保机器人运动的连续性与稳定性。在真实环境下基于宇树Go2四足机器人进行实验评估，结果表明SemGeoNav优于现有代表性方法（包括ViNT与NoMaD），实现了更高的成功率与更短的导航时间。

Authors: Yu Liu, Zongyang Chen, Yan Guo, Chao Liu, Xianfei Pan

ART-Glove: Articulated Tactile Glove for Contact-Grounded Dexterous Interaction Capture Manipulation

tactile glove dexterous manipulation contact geometry demonstration capture robot learning

简要说明：ART-Glove是一种触觉手套，通过明确的接触几何结构和关节/触觉传感捕捉灵巧操作演示，为机器人学习提供数据支持。

TLDR: ART-Glove is a tactile glove that captures dexterous manipulation demonstrations with explicit contact geometry and joint/tactile sensing, enabling data collection for robot learning.

Abstract: We present ART-Glove, an articulated tactile glove designed to capture contact-grounded dexterous demonstrations while preserving human dexterity. ART-Glove makes hand-side contact geometry explicit with 16 rigid functional surfaces covering the fingers, thumb, and palm. Twenty-two anatomically aligned joints connect these surfaces and allow them to follow human hand motion during dexterous manipulation. Encoder-based sensing tracks surface motion, while dense piezoresistive tactile sensing records contact over the same surfaces. The complete system captures synchronized 22-DoF joint measurements and 2048-taxel tactile measurements at 120 Hz. We evaluate ART-Glove across experiments on motion freedom, joint sensing, tactile sensing, and contact-rich interaction capture, demonstrating its ability to preserve human dexterity while recording contact-grounded information that can support downstream dexterous robot learning.

摘要（中文）：我们提出ART-Glove，一种旨在捕捉基于接触的灵巧操作演示、同时保留人类灵巧性的关节式触觉手套。ART-Glove通过覆盖手指、拇指和手掌的16个刚性功能表面，明确表达了手部接触几何结构。22个解剖学对齐的关节连接这些表面，使其能够在灵巧操作过程中跟随人类手部运动。基于编码器的传感技术追踪表面运动，而密集的压阻式触觉传感在同一表面记录接触信息。完整系统以120Hz频率同步采集22自由度关节测量数据与2048个触觉单元的触觉测量数据。我们通过运动自由度、关节传感、触觉传感及接触密集型交互捕捉等系列实验对ART-Glove进行评测，证明其在记录可支撑下游灵巧机器人学习的接触信息时，能够保持人类灵巧性。

Authors: Changyi Lin, Ding Zhao

TopoRetarget: Interaction-Preserving Retargeting for Dexterous Manipulation Manipulation

retargeting dexterous manipulation interaction preservation reinforcement learning reference tracking

简要说明：TopoRetarget 是一个重定向框架，在将人类演示迁移到灵巧机器人手时保持手-物体交互结构，从而提升下游强化学习策略性能并实现零样本硬件迁移。

TLDR: TopoRetarget is a retargeting framework that preserves hand-object interaction structure when transferring human demonstrations to dexterous robot hands, improving downstream RL policy performance and enabling zero-shot hardware transfer.

Abstract: Human hand-object demonstrations provide dense reference motions for training dexterous manipulation reinforcement learning (RL) policies through reference tracking. However, to use such demonstrations for RL policy learning, retargeting must preserve hand pose and task-relevant hand-object contact structure. Otherwise, contact and feasibility artifacts can degrade downstream RL policy performance. We introduce TopoRetarget, an interaction-preserving retargeting framework that uses a single set of parameters across diverse retargeting conditions while maintaining task-relevant hand-object interaction and adapting human demonstrations to dexterous robot hands. The method constructs a sparse interaction graph over hand and object keypoints and optimizes distance-weighted Laplacian deformation with directional consistency, kinematic constraints, and penetration handling. Evaluations show that the generated references improve both interaction fidelity and policy learning: TopoRetarget achieves the best contact precision and alignment over all baselines on the ContactPose Dataset, improves Pen-Spin training success by 40.6 percentage points over the existing baseline methods, and enables zero-shot transfer to Wuji Hand hardware on cube reorientation and pen spinning.

摘要（中文）：人类手-物体演示为通过参考跟踪训练灵巧操作强化学习策略提供了密集的参考运动。然而，要利用此类演示进行强化学习策略学习，重定向必须保留手部姿态以及与任务相关的手-物体接触结构。否则，接触和可行性伪影可能会降低下游强化学习策略的性能。我们提出了TopoRetarget，这是一种保持交互性的重定向框架，该框架能够在多种重定向条件下使用单一参数集，同时维持与任务相关的手-物体交互，并将人类演示适配到灵巧机器人手。该方法在手和物体关键点上构建稀疏交互图，并通过方向一致性、运动学约束和穿透处理优化距离加权拉普拉斯变形。评估表明，所生成的参考能够同时提升交互保真度和策略学习效果：TopoRetarget在ContactPose数据集上实现了所有基线方法中最优的接触精度和对齐效果，将旋转笔训练成功率较现有基线方法提升了40.6个百分点，并在立方体重定向和旋转笔任务上实现了向Wuji硬件的零样本迁移。

Authors: Jielin Wu, Shenzhe Yao, Guanqi He, Xiaohan Liu, Zhaoqing Zeng, Xiangrui Jiang, Han Yang, Wentao Zhang, Hang Zhao

A Deployment Case Study in Robotic Apparel Automation: Digital Twin Integration, Interoperability, and Workforce Enablement Manipulation

robotic sewing digital twin digital thread interoperability deployment

简要说明：一项关于牛仔布制造机器人缝纫系统部署的案例研究，重点包括数字孪生验证、数字线程自动化、互操作性、运行时验证和操作员培训。

TLDR: A case study of deploying a robotic sewing system for denim manufacturing, focusing on digital twin validation, digital thread automation, interoperability, runtime verification, and operator training.

Abstract: Despite steady advances in flexible automation in sectors such as electronics and automotive manufacturing, apparel automation remains challenging because fabrics are deformable and difficult to manipulate with robots. This paper presents a deployment-oriented case study of a robotic sewing system for denim manufacturing, emphasizing the system-level integration required for practical adoption. At the engineering level, a digital thread module parses DXF production drawings into process parameters and executable robot trajectories, reducing manual programming effort and enabling rapid re-targeting across sewing operations. In parallel, a digital twin of the workcell is used during pre-deployment to validate reach and clearance, refine layout and sequencing, evaluate operator access, and assess cycle-time compatibility with upstream and downstream tasks, thereby reducing commissioning risk. At deployment, the system integrates a collaborative robot with conventional sewing equipment, welding, suction fixtures, and machine-level controllers through an interoperability layer. Runtime monitoring and verification, including seam monitoring, collision checking, and trajectory-level validation, improve robustness under environmental variability, while operator-facing training and guidance tools support setup, troubleshooting, and technology adoption. Two staged factory deployments on denim shorts, covering 2D pocket operations and 3D garment-shaping seams, show that digital-twin-based validation, digital-thread-driven task generation, interoperability, runtime verification, and operator training are important for scaling robotic apparel automation.

摘要（中文）：尽管在电子和汽车制造等行业，柔性自动化已取得稳步进展，但由于织物具有可变形性且难以通过机器人操作，服装自动化仍面临挑战。本文介绍了一项面向部署的牛仔服装制造机器人缝纫系统案例研究，重点强调了实际应用所需的系统级集成。在工程层面上，数字线程模块可将DXF生产图纸解析为工艺参数和可执行的机器人轨迹，从而减少人工编程工作量，并实现跨缝纫工序的快速重定位。同时，在部署前利用工作单元的数字孪生验证可达性与间隙、优化布局与排序、评估操作员介入可行性，并检测节拍与上下游任务的兼容性，从而降低调试风险。部署阶段，系统通过互操作层将协作机器人、传统缝纫设备、焊接与吸盘夹具及机器级控制器集成一体。运行时监控与验证（包括缝迹监测、碰撞检测及轨迹级验证）提升了在环境变化条件下的鲁棒性，而面向操作员的培训与引导工具则支持设备设置、故障排除及技术采纳。针对牛仔短裤的两阶段工厂部署（涵盖二维口袋工序与三维服装成型缝线）表明，基于数字孪生的验证、数字线程驱动的任务生成、互操作性、运行时验证及操作员培训对于规模化推广机器人服装自动化至关重要。

Authors: Gokul Narayanan, Abhiroop Ajith, Jonathan Zornow, Carlos Calle, Auralis Herrero Lugo, Jose Luis Susa Rincon, Chengtao Wen, Eugen Solowjow

Semantic Flip: Synthetic OOD Generation for Robust Refusal in Embodied Question Answering and Spatial Localization VLN

out-of-distribution detection embodied refusal vision-language models spatial localization benchmark

简要说明：Semantic Flip 提出了一种框架，通过生成合成分布外查询-视频对来训练冻结 VLM 上的轻量级拒绝模块，从而在具身问答和空间定位中实现稳健的拒绝。

TLDR: Semantic Flip proposes a framework that generates synthetic out-of-distribution query-video pairs to train a lightweight rejection module for frozen VLMs, enabling robust refusal in embodied question answering and spatial localization.

Abstract: Detecting unanswerable user queries remains essential for the reliable deployment of real-world embodied agents. However, modern vision-language models (VLMs) often generate overly confident answers even when the available visual memory cannot support the query. Such overconfidence poses various task-dependent risks. The agent may provide misleading information to the user in Embodied Question Answering and select an arbitrary coordinate and physically guide the user there in spatial reasoning for navigation. Despite these high stakes, only a few prior studies directly address when and how an embodied VLM should respond with "I do not know." This work proposes Semantic Flip, a simple yet effective framework that synthesizes auxiliary out-of-distribution (OOD) samples for embodied refusal without requiring external OOD annotations. The key idea is to independently transform the query and video memory to construct auxiliary OOD pairs that lack sufficient visual grounding. These synthesized pairs enable training a lightweight rejection module on top of a frozen pretrained VLM. The module attaches to any existing VLM-based pipeline without retraining the underlying model. Across two complementary benchmarks, Semantic Flip consistently outperforms strong prompting baselines. This work also introduces SpaceReject, a new refusal benchmark for spatial localization with deliberately unanswerable queries over long video memory, where Semantic Flip achieves an $F_1$ score of 0.9559. The source codes and datasets are publicly available at https://github.com/ndb796/SemanticFlip.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 检测不可回答的用户查询对于现实世界中具身智能体的可靠部署至关重要。然而，现代的视觉-语言模型（VLM）即使可用的视觉记忆无法支持查询，也常常生成过于自信的答案。这种过度自信会带来各种依赖任务的风险。在具身问答中，智能体可能向用户提供误导性信息；在空间导航推理中，智能体可能选择一个任意坐标并实际引导用户前往该位置。尽管风险极高，但仅有少数先前研究直接探讨了具身VLM应在何时以及如何回答“我不知道”。本文提出Semantic Flip，一种简单而有效的框架，该框架无需外部OOD标注即可合成用于具身拒绝的辅助分布外（OOD）样本。其核心思想是独立变换查询和视频记忆，构建缺乏足够视觉基础的辅助OOD配对。这些合成配对使得能够在冻结的预训练VLM之上训练一个轻量化的拒绝模块。该模块可附加到任何现有的基于VLM的流水线中，而无需重新训练底层模型。在两个互补的基准测试上，Semantic Flip一致优于强提示基线方法。本文还引入了SpaceReject，这是一个针对长视频记忆中故意不可回答查询的空间定位拒绝新基准，在该基准上Semantic Flip的$F_1$分数达到0.9559。源代码和数据集已公开于 https://github.com/ndb796/SemanticFlip。

Authors: Dongbin Na, Chanwoo Kim, Giyun Choi, Dooyoung Hong

Learned Image Compression for Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

learned image compression VLA models adaptive rate control bitrate allocation robotic control

简要说明：本文提出SPARC，一种针对VLA驱动机器人的学习式图像压缩框架，根据任务相关性自适应分配比特率，在带宽受限条件下提升控制性能。

TLDR: This paper presents SPARC, a learned image compression framework that adaptively allocates bitrate based on task relevance for VLA-driven robots, improving control performance under bandwidth constraints.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly rely on high-frequency multi-camera observations, making visual communication a major bottleneck for real-time robotic control in bandwidth-constrained or distributed deployment settings. Existing image and video codecs, however, are designed to preserve generic visual fidelity rather than the control performance of downstream VLA policies. In this work, we introduce SPARC (SPatially Adaptive Rate Control), a learned image compression framework tailored for VLA-driven robots. Our key observation is that the importance of visual information varies substantially across both camera views and spatial regions within an image. Based on this observation, SPARC employs a lightweight temporal mask selector that adaptively allocates bitrate over latent representations according to task relevance while leveraging temporal context. We further introduce a tilted rate loss that stabilizes training by reducing the tendency of entropy-based objectives to over-suppress rare yet task-critical visual patterns. Experiments on diverse robotic benchmarks, including RoboCasa365, VLABench, and LIBERO, show that SPARC consistently achieves stronger control performance than conventional image/video codecs and recent learned compression methods under the same bitrate budget. We additionally demonstrate real-world deployment benefits in remote-control settings, where our method substantially improves the bitrate-success tradeoff.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型日益依赖高频多摄像头观测，这使得视觉通信成为带宽受限或分布式部署场景下实时机器人控制的主要瓶颈。然而，现有图像与视频编解码器的设计目标是保持通用视觉保真度，而非下游VLA策略的控制性能。本文提出SPARC（空间自适应码率控制），这是一种专为VLA驱动型机器人设计的可学习图像压缩框架。我们的关键发现是：视觉信息的重要性在不同摄像头视角以及图像内的空间区域之间存在显著差异。基于这一发现，SPARC采用轻量级时间掩码选择器，根据任务相关性自适应地在潜在表征上分配比特率，同时利用时间上下文信息。我们进一步引入倾斜率损失，通过降低基于熵的目标函数过度抑制罕见但任务关键型视觉模式的倾向来稳定训练。在包括RoboCasa365、VLABench和LIBERO在内的多样化机器人基准测试中，实验表明：在相同比特率预算下，SPARC相比传统图像/视频编解码器及近期可学习压缩方法始终能实现更强的控制性能。我们还展示了该方法在远程控制场景下的实际部署优势——显著提升了比特率与成功率之间的权衡表现。

Authors: Hyeonjun Kim, Jegwang Ryu, Sangbeom Ha, Junhyeok Lee, Jun-Hyuk Kim, Hyemin Ahn, Jaeho Lee

BRDFusion: Physics Meets Generation for Urban Scene Inverse Rendering AutonomousDriving

inverse rendering urban scene generative priors physical modeling autonomous driving simulation

简要说明：BRDFusion 将基于物理的渲染与生成先验相结合，为城市场景逆渲染生成高质量、可控的视频，支持自动驾驶仿真和新视角重光照等应用。

TLDR: BRDFusion combines physically-based rendering with generative priors to produce high-quality, controllable videos for urban scene inverse rendering, supporting applications like autonomous driving simulation and novel-view relighting.

Abstract: Inverse rendering of urban scenes from captured videos enables numerous applications, including content creation and autonomous driving simulation. Physically-based rendering methods follow and control lighting physics, but suffer from reconstruction and rendering artifacts. While generative models produce realistic videos, they offer limited consistency and controllability. We present BRDFusion, a unified framework that combines two complementary models for inverse and forward rendering. Specifically, BRDFusion recovers explicit, consistent scene properties with physical modeling and alleviates optimization ambiguity with generative priors. During forward rendering, the physical model provides controllable rendering from the scene configuration, and the generative model denoises and fixes artifacts. Therefore, our method produces high-quality videos while allowing precise control, outperforming baselines in real and synthetic scenes. Moreover, BRDFusion supports novel-view relighting, night simulation, and dynamic object insertion/editing. Project page: https://shigon255.github.io/brdfusion-page/

摘要（中文）：从拍摄视频中实现城市场景的逆渲染可应用于诸多领域，包括内容生成与自动驾驶仿真。基于物理的渲染方法能够遵循并控制光照物理规律，但存在重建与渲染伪影问题。生成模型虽能产生逼真的视频，但其一致性与可控性有限。本文提出BRDFusion，一个统一框架，将两种互补模型分别用于逆渲染与前向渲染。具体而言，BRDFusion通过物理建模恢复显式且一致的场景属性，并借助生成先验缓解优化过程中的歧义性。在前向渲染阶段，物理模型可根据场景配置实现可控渲染，而生成模型则负责去噪并修复伪影。因此，本方法能够在实现精确控制的前提下生成高质量视频，在真实与合成场景中均优于基线方法。此外，BRDFusion支持新视角重光照、夜间仿真以及动态物体插入/编辑。项目页面：https://shigon255.github.io/brdfusion-page/

Authors: Yi-Ruei Liu, Jie-Ying Lee, Zheng-Hui Huang, Yu-Lun Liu, Chih-Hao Lin

SurroundNEXO: Ego-Centric Metric Bridging for Spatially Consistent Geometry in Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

multi-camera depth spatial consistency ego-ray positional encoding LiDAR metric anchors surround-view

简要说明：SurroundNEXO提出了一种用于自动驾驶的低重叠多相机度量深度框架，通过自我射线位置编码和稀疏激光雷达锚点，在弱重叠视图间实现空间一致的几何结构。

TLDR: SurroundNEXO introduces a low-overlap multi-camera metric depth framework for autonomous driving, using ego-ray positional encoding and sparse LiDAR anchors to achieve spatially consistent geometry across weakly overlapping views.

Abstract: Modern autonomous driving depends on accurate metric 3D understanding for perception, reconstruction, and planning, which in turn requires reliable multi-camera depth prediction. However, the outward-facing nature of vehicle-mounted surround-view camera rigs inherently limits visual overlap across views, challenging the correspondence-based assumptions that underpin conventional multi-view geometry. To bridge this gap, we present SurroundNEXO, named after the Spanish word nexo for a geometric link, a low-overlap multi-camera metric depth framework that grounds cross-view reasoning in ego-centric geometry rather than dense visual correspondences. Instead of directly enforcing early global fusion, SurroundNEXO first assigns image tokens globally comparable ego-frame viewing directions through Ego-Ray Positional Encoding, then uses sparse LiDAR measurements as metric anchors to propagate absolute scale cues, and finally expands feature interaction progressively from view-local modeling to decomposed spatio-temporal reasoning and global integration. This design enables metric-scale depth prediction with improved spatial consistency across weakly overlapping cameras. Across low-overlap autonomous driving benchmarks, including NuScenes, Waymo and DDAD, SurroundNEXO reduces single-view error by 33.2%, improves cross-view consistency by 10.5%, and enhances metric reconstruction quality by 25.6% compared with SOTA methods. It further remains robust under extremely sparse depth prompts and exhibits strong zero-shot generalization to unseen camera layouts.

摘要（中文）：现代自动驾驶依赖于精确的度量三维理解来实现感知、重建与规划，这进而需要可靠的多相机深度预测。然而，车载环视相机系统中各相机朝外的固有特性本就限制了视角间的视觉重叠，对支撑传统多视角几何的基于对应关系的假设提出了挑战。为弥合这一差距，我们提出SurroundNEXO（源自西班牙语nexo，意为几何纽带），这是一种低重叠多相机度量深度框架，其跨视角推理基于自我中心几何而非密集视觉对应。SurroundNEXO并非直接实施早期全局融合，而是首先通过Ego-Ray位置编码为图像标记分配全局可比的自我框架视角方向，然后利用稀疏激光雷达测量作为度量锚点以传播绝对尺度线索，最后逐步将特征交互从视角局部建模扩展至分解的时空推理与全局集成。该设计使得在弱重叠相机间能够实现具有改善空间一致性的度量尺度深度预测。在包含NuScenes、Waymo及DDAD的低重叠自动驾驶基准测试中，相较于现有最优方法，SurroundNEXO将单视角误差降低33.2%，跨视角一致性提升10.5%，度量重建质量提高25.6%。此外，该方法在极端稀疏深度提示下仍保持鲁棒性，并对未见过的相机布局展现出强大的零样本泛化能力。

Authors: Shuai Yuan, Runxi Tang, Yuzhou Ji, Fudong Ge, Hanshi Wang, Yifei Wang, Xianming Zeng, Jianyun Xu, Xingliang Liu, Yanfeng Wang, Zhipeng Zhang

Effective and Low-cost Lane-based Map Localization for Vehicle-Centric Route Generation AutonomousDriving

lane-based map localization vehicle-centric route generation driver-view-aligned route low-cost framework nuScenes dataset

简要说明：OLRA是一种低成本框架，通过将地图导航路线与相机检测到的车道标记对齐来生成与驾驶员视角对齐的路线，提升了车辆定位精度和路线准确性，尤其在复杂路段表现出色。

TLDR: OLRA is a low-cost framework that aligns map-based navigation routes with camera-detected lane markings to derive driver-view-aligned routes, improving vehicle localization and route accuracy, especially in complex road segments.

Abstract: Driver-centric route representation plays a vital role in intuitive driving guidance systems. This paper presents OLRA, a low-cost, map-localization-based framework that derives driver-view-aligned routes by matching map-based navigation routes with camera-detected lane markings. This alignment process mutually enhances vehicle localization accuracy and visual route consistency. To bridge the evaluation gap across different paradigms, we introduce practical route evaluation metrics and benchmark OLRA against OpenPilot, a representative direct-generation approach. Experimental results on the nuScenes dataset demonstrate that OLRA outperforms OpenPilot in complex road segments and in route estimation at distance beyond 20 meters, achieving lower overall Euclidean error. This study is expected to promote future research in low-cost, maplocalization-based route generation methods.

摘要（中文）：以驾驶者为中心的路径呈现在直觉式驾驶引导系统中扮演着关键角色。本文提出OLRA——一种基于地图定位的低成本框架，通过将地图导航路径与摄像头检测的车道标线进行匹配，生成与驾驶者视角对齐的路径。这一对齐过程同步提升了车辆定位精度与视觉路径一致性。为弥合不同范式间的评估差异，我们引入了实用路径评估指标，并将OLRA与具有代表性的直接生成方法OpenPilot进行对比。基于nuScenes数据集的实验结果表明，OLRA在复杂路段及超过20米距离的路径估计任务中均优于OpenPilot，且整体欧氏误差更低。本研究有望推动低成本、基于地图定位的路径生成方法的后续探索。

Authors: Hong-Shiang Lin, Jung-Hsin Chen, Yu-Luen Tzeng, Wei-Hao Chen, Yi-Chen Lee, Li-Jhe Chen, Peng-Yuan Chen

PROSE: Training-Free Egocentric Scene Registration with Vision-Language Models Other

egocentric scene registration vision-language model 3D scene graph object matching prompting

简要说明：PROSE利用预训练的视觉语言模型，通过构建对象级3D场景图并提示VLM匹配对象来注册自中心RGB序列，无需训练或深度传感器即在注册精度上达到最优。

TLDR: PROSE uses a pretrained vision-language model to register egocentric RGB sequences of indoor spaces by constructing object-level 3D scene graphs and prompting the VLM to match objects, achieving training-free state-of-the-art registration without depth sensors or annotated graphs.

Abstract: Registering two captures of the same indoor space taken at different times underpins persistent spatial memory for robots and AR systems, yet the realistic version of this task is egocentric and its most scalable form is RGB-only. Head-mounted cameras yield blurry, fast-moving, partially overlapping views from which dense geometry is hard to recover. Classical registration leans on exactly the clean point clouds this setting lacks, while learned scene-graph methods require a pre-built or annotated graph and a trained matcher that we find brittle under egocentric data. We take a different route, using a pretrained vision-language model as the source of both scene understanding and cross-scan matching. Our method, PROSE (Prompted Scene rEgistration), lifts each RGB sequence into an object-level 3D scene graph using off-the-shelf foundation models for geometry, segmentation, and language, then prompts the same VLM to match object instances across the two RGB sequences. To make this matching tractable and reliable, we leverage object heights as a prior and verify each proposed match with a paired same/different query, then solve for the rigid transform by hypothesizing a candidate per matched object and selecting the one with the strongest geometric consensus. PROSE adds no learned parameters and requires no depth sensor, training, or annotated graph. On the egocentric Aria Digital Twin and Aria Everyday Activities benchmarks, it outperforms both geometric and learned scene-graph baselines in registration accuracy, on ground-truth and RGB-reconstructed point clouds alike, and the scene graph it produces transfers directly to downstream tasks.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 对同一室内空间在不同时刻拍摄的两组数据进行配准，是机器人与增强现实系统实现持久空间记忆的基础，但该任务的实际版本具有自我中心特性，且其最具可扩展性的形式仅依赖RGB数据。头戴式相机产生的图像模糊、运动快速、视野部分重叠，难以从中恢复稠密几何结构。经典配准方法依赖于该场景所欠缺的干净点云，而基于学习的场景图方法则需要预先构建或标注的场景图以及训练好的匹配器——我们在自我中心数据中发现这类匹配器稳定性较差。我们另辟蹊径，采用预训练的视觉-语言模型同时作为场景理解与跨扫描匹配的来源。所提方法PROSE（提示式场景配准）利用现成的基础模型（几何、分割与语言）将每段RGB序列提升为对象级3D场景图，随后通过提示同一视觉-语言模型对两段RGB序列中的对象实例进行匹配。为使该匹配过程可行且可靠，我们以对象高度作为先验，并通过成对“相同/不同”查询验证每个候选匹配，再针对每个匹配对象假设一个候选变换，最终通过几何一致性最强准则确定刚体变换。PROSE无需添加任何可学习参数，也不需要深度传感器、训练过程或标注场景图。在自我中心的Aria数字孪生与Aria日常活动基准测试中，无论使用真实点云还是RGB重建点云，该方法在配准精度上均优于几何方法与基于学习的场景图基线方法，且其生成的场景图可直接迁移至下游任务。

Authors: Zhiang Chen, Nahyuk Lee, Boyang Sun, Taein Kwon, Marc Pollefeys, Zuria Bauer, Sunghwan Hong

Elastic ODYN: Differentiable Optimization for Infeasible Control and Learning in Robotics Other

differentiable optimization quadratic program elastic relaxation control infeasibility

简要说明：Elastic ODYN 是一种可微的二次规划求解器，通过平滑弹性松弛处理不可行的控制和学习问题，在四足和人形轨迹优化等机器人任务上进行了评估。

TLDR: Elastic ODYN is a differentiable QP solver that handles infeasible control and learning problems via smooth elastic relaxations, evaluated on robotics tasks like quadrupedal and humanoid trajectory optimization.

Abstract: Robotic systems routinely encounter conflicting objectives, modeling errors, and degenerate contact conditions that render quadratic programs (QPs) infeasible. Yet most optimization solvers and differentiable QP layers assume feasibility, leading to numerical failures, unstable gradients, or solver breakdown when constraints cannot be simultaneously satisfied. We present Elastic ODYN, a primal--dual non-interior-point QP solver that handles infeasibility through smooth squared-$\ell_2$ elastic relaxations. The resulting formulation remains well posed under ill-conditioning and degeneracy, supports warm starting, and converges to closest-to-feasible solutions when no feasible point exists. A lightweight refinement stage recovers physically meaningful dual variables from the elastic solution. Building on this framework, we develop Elastic OdynLayer, a differentiable QP layer with stable gradients under infeasibility, and Elastic OdynSQP, an infeasibility-aware SQP method that resolves inconsistent subproblems and intrinsically infeasible optimal control tasks through selective constraint relaxation. We evaluate the framework on benchmark QPs, singular contact mechanics, differentiable parameter identification, and quadrupedal and humanoid trajectory optimization. Across all settings, Elastic ODYN consistently outperforms state-of-the-art elastic QP solvers in robustness, warm-start performance, and convergence reliability, enabling optimization, simulation, control, and learning beyond the feasibility assumptions of existing methods.

摘要（中文）：机器人系统经常会遇到相互冲突的目标、建模误差以及退化的接触条件，这些情况会导致二次规划（QP）不可行。然而，大多数优化求解器和可微QP层都假定问题是可行的，当约束条件无法同时满足时，就会导致数值失败、梯度不稳定或求解器崩溃。我们提出了Elastic ODYN，这是一种原-对偶非内点QP求解器，通过平滑的$\ell_2$范数平方弹性松弛来处理不可行性。由此产生的公式在病态和退化情况下仍保持良好的适定性，支持热启动，并在不存在可行点时收敛到最接近可行的解。一个轻量级的精化阶段可从弹性解中恢复具有物理意义的对偶变量。在此框架基础上，我们开发了Elastic OdynLayer（一个在不可行条件下具有稳定梯度的可微QP层）和Elastic OdynSQP（一种对不可行性敏感的SQP方法，通过选择性约束松弛来解决不一致的子问题和本质上不可行的最优控制任务）。我们在基准QP、奇异接触力学、可微参数辨识以及四足和类人机器人轨迹优化上评估了该框架。在所有设置中，Elastic ODYN在鲁棒性、热启动性能和收敛可靠性方面始终优于最先进的弹性QP求解器，使得优化、仿真、控制和学习能够超越现有方法的可行性假设。

Authors: Aristotelis Papatheodorou, Jose Rojas, Ioannis Havoutis, Carlos Mastalli

Friction Characterization of a Cable-Driven Differential Actuation System for Lower-Limb Exoskeletons Locomotion

differential actuation friction estimation sensorless torque control lower-limb exoskeleton cable-driven

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于下肢外骨骼的缆绳驱动差动执行系统，并通过基于模型的摩擦估计实现无传感器扭矩控制。

TLDR: This paper presents a cable-driven differential actuation system for lower-limb exoskeletons with model-based friction estimation for sensorless torque control.

Abstract: Lower-limb exoskeletons require actuation systems that can provide accurate joint torque control while preserving low mass and encumbrance. Conventional architectures often rely on independently actuated joints and joint-level torque sensors, increasing system complexity and weight. This paper presents a novel differential actuation architecture for hip-knee flexion/extension, enabling cooperative torque sharing between two motors via a linear differential mapping between motor and joint. To compensate for transmission losses, a model-based friction estimation strategy is developed and experimentally implemented, allowing accurate joint torque estimation without the need for torque sensors. The proposed solution is validated on a physical prototype, demonstrating the feasibility of sensorless torque estimation in a differentially actuated hip-knee module of a lower-limb exoskeleton.

摘要（中文）：下肢外骨骼需要能够在保持低质量和低负担的同时提供精确关节扭矩控制的驱动系统。传统架构通常依赖独立驱动的关节和关节级扭矩传感器，这增加了系统的复杂性和重量。本文提出了一种用于髋-膝关节屈曲/伸展的新型差动驱动架构，通过电机与关节之间的线性差动映射，实现两个电机之间的协同扭矩分配。为补偿传动损耗，开发并实验验证了一种基于模型的摩擦估计策略，无需扭矩传感器即可实现精确的关节扭矩估计。所提方案在物理样机上得到验证，证明了在下肢外骨骼差动驱动髋-膝关节模块中实现无传感器扭矩估计的可行性。
