Authors: Alberto Maria Nobili, Fabio Salsedo, Alessandro Filippeschi

ActiveSAM: Image-Conditional Class Pruning for Fast and Accurate Open-Vocabulary Segmentation AutonomousDriving

open-vocabulary segmentation class pruning zero-shot inference SAM 3 robustness

简要说明：ActiveSAM 提出了一种零样本、无需训练的推理框架，通过动态修剪每张图像的类别提示来加速 SAM 3 进行开放词汇分割，在实现 SOTA 精度的同时速度提升最高 5.5 倍，并明确声称适用于自动驾驶和具身 AI。

TLDR: ActiveSAM introduces a zero-shot, training-free inference framework that accelerates SAM 3 for open-vocabulary segmentation by dynamically pruning class prompts per image, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy and up to 5.5x speedup, with explicit claims of suitability for autonomous driving and embodied AI.

Abstract: Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM 3) provides a strong frozen backbone for concept-prompted segmentation, but applying it directly to open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) is inefficient: full-resolution decoding is typically run over the entire dataset vocabulary, whereas each image contains only a small active subset of classes. We introduce ActiveSAM, a training-free, zero-shot inference framework that turns SAM 3 into an active-vocabulary segmenter. ActiveSAM first canonicalizes and expands class prompts, then estimates an image-conditioned active set from a low-resolution presence preview. Only the retained classes are decoded at full resolution, using bucketed prompt multiplexing with the frozen SAM 3 decoder. The preview stage uses only class-presence evidence and skips unnecessary segmentation-head computation, while the final stage applies margin-aware background calibration to suppress low-confidence pixels. ActiveSAM requires no target-dataset training, no weight updates, and no oracle class-presence labels. Across eight OVSS benchmarks, ActiveSAM improves the speed-accuracy tradeoff of training-free open-vocabulary semantic segmentation, outperforming the current state-of-the-art SegEarth-OV3 by approximately +1.4 mIoU on average while running up to 5.5x faster on large-vocabulary datasets. ActiveSAM also demonstrates the strongest robustness under image corruption that simulates real-world distribution shift, making it well-suited for deployment in noisy-input domains such as autonomous driving and embodied AI. Code is available at https://github.com/VILA-Lab/ActiveSAM.

摘要（中文）：三段式模型3（SAM 3）为概念提示分割提供了强大的冻结骨干网络，但将其直接应用于开放词汇语义分割（OVSS）效率低下：全分辨率解码通常需处理整个数据集词汇表，而每张图像仅包含少量活跃类别子集。我们提出ActiveSAM，一种无需训练、零样本推理框架，将SAM 3转化为主动词汇分割器。ActiveSAM首先对类别提示进行规范化和扩展，然后通过低分辨率存在性预览估计图像条件化的活跃集合。仅对保留的类别进行全分辨率解码，利用带桶式提示复用的冻结SAM 3解码器。预览阶段仅使用类别存在性证据，跳过不必要的分割头计算；最终阶段应用边界感知背景校准以抑制低置信度像素。ActiveSAM无需目标数据集训练、权重更新或先验类别存在性标签。在八个OVSS基准测试中，ActiveSAM改善了无训练开放词汇语义分割的速度-精度权衡，平均mIoU比当前最先进的SegEarth-OV3提升约+1.4，同时在大型词汇数据集上运行速度最高提升5.5倍。ActiveSAM在模拟真实分布偏移的图像损坏下展现出最强鲁棒性，使其非常适合部署在自动驾驶、具身智能等噪声输入领域。代码开源在https://github.com/VILA-Lab/ActiveSAM。

Authors: Tran Dinh Tien, Zhiqiang Shen

Mind-Studio: Executable World Models with Lookahead Evaluation for Partially Observable Games WorldModel

world model executable program lookahead fidelity LLM partially observable games

简要说明：Mind-Studio 利用大语言模型从交互数据合成可执行的 pygame 风格世界模型，在 Atari 游戏上实现高前瞻保真度。

TLDR: Mind-Studio uses LLMs to synthesize executable pygame-style world models from interaction data, achieving high lookahead fidelity on Atari games.

Abstract: World-model synthesis aims to turn interaction experience into an internal model of environment dynamics. Existing symbolic approaches often fit observed transitions or mixtures of local rules, but they do not produce a complete executable program that can run independently of the real environment. We present Mind-Studio, a framework that synthesizes executable pygame-style world models from state-action-next-state trajectories using large language models. Mind-Studio combines entropy-selected traces with a lightweight game skill file containing object, action, and static scene information extracted from screenshots. We evaluate synthesis quality with a K-step lookahead fidelity protocol that compares generated world-model rollouts against Real-ALE rollouts from the same state. On Montezuma's Revenge, Mind-Studio improves chosen-action next-state prediction from 0.3% for PoE-World to 48.7% while verifying 5 of 8 subgoals; across Alien, Assault, and Skiing, it achieves stronger branch-level fidelity than prior learned lookahead sources.

摘要（中文）：世界模型综合旨在将交互经验转化为环境动态的内部模型。现有的符号方法通常拟合观测到的转移规律或局部规则的混合，但无法生成可独立于真实环境运行的完整可执行程序。我们提出Mind-Studio框架，该框架利用大语言模型从状态-动作-下一状态轨迹中综合生成可执行的pygame风格世界模型。Mind-Studio将熵筛选轨迹与轻量级游戏技能文件相结合，该文件包含从截图中提取的对象、动作和静态场景信息。我们采用K步前视保真度协议评估综合质量，该协议将生成的世界模型推演结果与基于相同状态的真实ALE推演结果进行对比。在《蒙特祖玛的复仇》游戏中，Mind-Studio将所选动作的下一状态预测准确率从PoE-World的0.3%提升至48.7%，同时验证了8个子目标中的5个；在《太空入侵者》、《突击》和《滑雪》游戏中，其分支级保真度优于以往学习型前视方法。

Authors: Yifei Dong, Mingen Zheng, Linquan Wu, Jeff Z. Pan, Jiaxin Bai

DreamX-World 1.0: A General-Purpose Interactive World Model WorldModel

world model interactive generation camera control autoregressive video event tuning

简要说明：DreamX-World 1.0是一个通用的交互式世界模型，支持可控的长时序视频生成，具有相机导航、事件控制和跨域的视觉记忆持久化能力。

TLDR: DreamX-World 1.0 is a general-purpose interactive world model for controllable long-horizon video generation, supporting camera navigation, event control, and memory persistence across photorealistic, game-style, and stylized domains.

Abstract: DreamX-World 1.0 is a general-purpose interactive text/image-to-video world model for controllable long-horizon generation. It supports camera navigation, revisits to previously observed regions, and promptable events across photorealistic, game-style, and stylized domains. Our data engine combines camera-accurate Unreal Engine rendering, action-rich gameplay recordings, and real-world videos with recovered camera geometry. For camera control, we introduce E-PRoPE, a lightweight variant of projective positional encoding that retains PRoPE's projective camera geometry while applying camera-aware attention to spatially reduced tokens. We convert a bidirectional video generator into a few-step autoregressive world model using causal forcing, DMD-style distillation, and long-rollout training. Training on self-generated long-horizon contexts exposes the model to its own generated history and reduces the style and color drift that accumulates across autoregressive chunks. Memory-Conditioned Scene Persistence retrieves earlier views through camera-geometry-based retrieval, while residual recycling makes the conditioning path less sensitive to imperfect memory latents. Event Instruction Tuning adds composable event control, and reinforcement learning alignment recovers camera control and visual quality after distillation. With mixed-precision DiT execution, residual reuse, 75\%-pruned VAE decoding, and asynchronous pipeline parallelism, DreamX-World 1.0 reaches up to 16\,FPS on eight RTX\,5090 GPUs. On our 5-second basic evaluation, DreamX-World 1.0 achieves a camera-control score of 73.75 and an overall score of 84.76, outperforming HY-WorldPlay 1.5 and LingBot-World in overall score, which achieve 80.79 and 80.45, respectively.

摘要（中文）：DreamX-World 1.0 是一种通用的交互式文本/图像到视频世界模型，用于可控的长时程生成。它支持摄像机导航、对先前观察区域的重新访问，以及在逼真、游戏风格和风格化领域中的可提示事件。我们的数据引擎结合了摄像机精确的虚幻引擎渲染、动作丰富的游戏录制，以及带有恢复摄像机几何结构的真实世界视频。针对摄像机控制，我们引入了E-PRoPE，这是一种投影位置编码的轻量级变体，它在保留PRoPE的投影摄像机几何结构的同时，对空间缩减后的令牌应用了摄像机感知注意力。我们利用因果强制、DMD风格蒸馏和长序列展开训练，将双向视频生成器转换为几步自回归世界模型。在自生成长时程上下文上进行训练，使模型暴露于自身生成的历史中，并减少了跨自回归块累积的风格和色彩漂移。基于摄像机几何结构的检索，记忆条件场景持久化可获取早期视图，而残差循环则使条件路径对不完美的记忆潜在变量不那么敏感。事件指令微调增加了可组合的事件控制，而强化学习对齐则在蒸馏后恢复了摄像机控制和视觉质量。通过混合精度DiT执行、残差重用、75%剪枝的VAE解码以及异步流水线并行，DreamX-World 1.0在八块RTX 5090 GPU上可达16帧/秒。在我们的5秒基础评估中，DreamX-World 1.0获得了73.75的摄像机控制分数和84.76的总分，在总分上优于HY-WorldPlay 1.5和LingBot-World，后两者分别获得了80.79和80.45分。

Authors: DreamX Team, Yancheng Bai, Rui Chen, Xiangxiang Chu, Rujing Dang, Hao Dou, Bingjie Gao, Qiwen Gu, Siyu Hong, Jiachen Lei, Geng Li, Jifan Li, Ruimin Lin, Qingfeng Shi, Bingze Song, Lei Sun, Jing Tang, Ruitian Tian, Jun Wang, Jiahong Wu, Pengfei Zhang, Shen Zhang, Jiashu Zhu

BRICKS-WM: Building Reusability via Interface Composition Kinetics for Structured World Models WorldModel

structured world models model-based reinforcement learning latent dynamics factorization background dynamics reuse continuous control

简要说明：BRICKS-WM 提出了一种模块化世界模型分解方法，通过学习的潜在接口分离智能体和背景动态，使得冻结的背景动态可在不同智能体间重用。

TLDR: BRICKS-WM proposes a modular world model factorization separating agent and background dynamics via learned latent interfaces, enabling reuse of frozen background dynamics across different agents in continuous control tasks.

Abstract: Model-based Reinforcement Learning (MBRL) has achieved remarkable success in continuous control by leveraging latent world models. However, prevailing approaches typically rely on monolithic latent dynamics, entangling environment dynamics into a coupled process. This coupling severely limits reusability: altering the agent necessitates retraining the entire world from scratch, even if the environment remains constant. To address this, we introduce BRICKS-WM (Building Reusability via Interface Composition Kinetics for Structured World Models), a framework for the modular assembly of structured world models. Driven by the insight that the physical world is composed of independent entities, we posit that global dynamics can be modeled as a composition of distinct dynamical modules interacting via latent interfaces. As a minimal instantiation, we factorize the latent state space into an actuated Agent module and an external Background module, bridged by a learned latent interface. Unlike prior object-centric methods that prioritize visual segmentation, BRICKS-WM enforces a functional separation in transition dynamics, ensuring that background dynamics remains agnostic to the agent's dynamics. Empirically, BRICKS-WM achieves control performance comparable to strong monolithic baselines when trained from scratch, and enables the reuse of frozen background dynamics across agents.

摘要（中文）：基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）通过利用潜在世界模型在连续控制领域取得了显著成功。然而，现有方法通常依赖单一潜在动力学，将环境动态纠缠为一个耦合过程。这种耦合严重限制了可重用性：即使环境保持不变，改变智能体也需要从头重新训练整个世界模型。为解决这一问题，我们提出BRICKS-WM（通过接口组合动力学实现结构化世界模型的可重用性构建），一种用于模块化组装结构化世界模型的框架。基于物理世界由独立实体组成的洞察，我们假设全局动态可建模为不同动力学模块通过潜在接口交互的组合。作为最小化实例，我们将潜在状态空间分解为一个可驱动的智能体模块和一个外部背景模块，两者通过学习到的潜在接口连接。与以往强调视觉分割的以目标为中心的方法不同，BRICKS-WM在转移动态中强制执行功能分离，确保背景动态对智能体动态保持不可知性。实验表明，BRICKS-WM在从头训练时能达到与强单体基线相当的控制性能，并支持在不同智能体间重用冻结的背景动态。
